articleTitle: Research on HTTPS Service Identification Method, Device, Storage Medium and Electronic Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile Internet, HTTPS service plays an increasingly important role in the network. Due to the encrypted nature of HTTPS services, traditional service identification methods based on port numbers and load characteristics make it challenging to identify HTTPS services effectively. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an HTTPS service identification method based on three-party inspection. It utilizes the consistency of location information and service types between user equipment, servers, and mobile network operators to build a data table to identify HTTPS services accurately. This paper designs an HTTPS service identification system based on three-party inspection, including data acquisition, data preprocessing, and service identification modules. In addition, the service recognition module applies a deep neural network model to achieve efficient recognition of HTTPS services by training and optimizing the parameters. We analyzed the results of the proposed method based on the experimental data. We compared the performance of many other ways using Precision, Recall, and F1 values to verify the validity and superiority of the proposed method in this paper. In conclusion, the HTTPS service identification method based on the three-party inspection can improve the accuracy of service identification and provide strong support for the management and optimization of mobile networks.

articleTitle: Research on Image Classification and Retrieval Based on Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has attracted wide attention. It uses large-scale text-image pairs for collaborative learning to achieve cross-modal semantic understanding and retrieval. This paper studies image classification and retrieval methods and applications based on the CLIP model. First, this paper introduces the basic theory and structure of the CLIP model. It analyzes how it extracts the features of images and texts through comparative learning and maps them to the same semantic space. Second, we propose an image feature extraction and semantic embedding modeling method based on the CLIP model. The semantic representation of an image is obtained by encoding and aligning the image and text. Third, we construct an image classification neural network, which realizes images' automatic classification and annotation. The principal component analysis is applied in the research so that the semantic representation of the image is dimensionality reduction and visualized. The image retrieval based on text description is achieved. Finally, numerical examples are used to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method, and the influence of different factors on image classification and retrieval is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Water Quality Prediction and Optimization of Circulating Cooling Water System of Refrigeration System Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As cooling systems enter a new era, circulating cooling water systems also enter a period of high-quality development. Insisting on the cooling method with water quality as the core, we need to provide better prediction and optimization suggestions to meet the water quality requirements of cooling systems. Based on the dynamic evolution of water quality development in circulating cooling water systems and the inherent logic of water quality characteristics, a theoretical analysis framework for water quality prediction and optimization is constructed, which can explain the water quality optimization mechanism generated by the water quality prediction mechanism related to data acquisition and pretreatment and the support vector machine. In addition, from the perspective of experimental results and practice of water quality prediction and optimization, we continue to explore the possibility of moving towards high-quality development of circulating cooling water systems. The purpose of water quality prediction and optimization of circulating cooling water systems is to provide the refrigeration system with water quality that meets the expected standards, and managers are committed to continuously improving water quality and improving the satisfaction of refrigeration system use. To this end, we have taken a series of measures, including strengthening water quality control based on the internal cycle of water quality prediction, constructing a mechanism for interaction and optimization between water quality and support vector machine perception, and establishing an evaluation system for water quality and refrigeration systems. In this way, we will realize the high-quality development of the water quality of the circulating cooling water system, boost the refrigeration system, and truly meet the users' needs.

articleTitle: ARIMA-LSTM Model-Based Siting Study of Photovoltaic Power Generation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Electricity and energy are the foundation of China's economic and social development, and as China's demand for electricity continues to grow, it needs to change its electricity mix to increase the proportion of electricity generated from renewable sources. Photovoltaic (PV) power generation is an important renewable energy source, and China is still deficient in PV power generation. In this paper, we first collected data on China's electricity supply and five impact indicators from 2000 to 2023, and used Spearman correlation analysis to correlate the indicators; then we used the ARIMA-LSTM combination model to forecast the electricity supply, which lays a good foundation for the assessment of the siting of PV power generation. In order to determine the specific site selection, seven geographic units and provinces in China are specifically analyzed, and then the evaluation indicators are selected, and the optimal geographic units, optimal provinces and optimal regions for constructing PV power plants are derived by using the EWM-TOPSIS combinatorial model to demonstrate the feasibility of constructing PV power plants from different perspectives.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-expression Recognition Based on GAM Attention Mechanism and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Changes in facial micro-expressions are weak and short-lived, making it difficult for conventional methods to extract facial micro-expression features with differences effectively. An improved ResNetSO-GAM residual network is proposed in this research. A GAM attention module has been introduced to the body of the ResN et residual network to focus on subtle changes in facial micro-expressions quickly. In addition, we apply the practical information of the macro-expression dataset Fer2013 to facial micro-expression recognition through transfer learning. The ResN etSO-GAM network model suggested is assessed using the SAMM and CASME II datasets, which are popular for micro-expression studies. Furthermore, we compared the mainstream micro-expression recognition methods on the market. The experimental results show that the network model can achieve higher accuracy in the recognition.

articleTitle: Design of an Autonomous Cruising Scheme for Carrier-Based Aircraft Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous development of computer and unmanned control technology, and due to the low cost and high safety of drones, they have been widely used in various fields. As an unmanned aerial vehicle, drones can effectively reduce casualty rates in military applications and have important advantages as military weapons, making them an indispensable strategic force in the field of military operations. Carrier-based drone technology has become an important means for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, current drones mostly use GPS positioning and remote control to fly, which cannot achieve intelligent cruising and are limited by GPS signal accuracy. To improve the cruising efficiency and automation level of airborne drones, this paper proposes an autonomous cruising system based on machine vision combined with inertial sensors that utilizes visual altitude information of a single known point landmark to estimate the position and speed of the cruising drone. The system uses visual assistance to achieve long-duration flight and positioning and cruising by fusing data collected from multiple groups of infrared sensors, ultrasonic sensors, barometric sensors, and inertial sensors. The results of simulation experiments also demonstrate the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper, with certain feasibility.

articleTitle: Efficient Data Packet Sorting Method Based on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays On-Chip Random Access Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Research on efficient sorting algorithms is always an important research direction. The time complexity of traditional sorting algorithms is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{n}^{2})$</tex> or <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{O}(\mathrm{n}\times\log_{2}\mathrm{n})$</tex>, which still needs for further improvement. Due to its support for parallel computing and good real-time performance, FPGA has become one of the choices for algorithm acceleration. In this paper, a more efficient data packet sorting method based on FPGA's on-chip random access memory is proposed. This method establishes a mapping relationship between the feature field of data packets and the addresses of FPGA on-chip random access memory, and then writes the data packets into the RAM according to the mapping relationship. Due to the ordered nature of RAM addresses, the data packets written into the RAM naturally form an ordered queue when read out in address order. During the process of reading the RAM, an index registers are used to mark the status of each address of the random-access memory, thereby skipping empty addresses and only reading the addresses that store valid data packets. This method fully utilizes the hardware features of FPGA, not only transforming the complex sorting process into simple RAM write operations, but also requiring only 2 clock cycles to sort each signal, thus reducing the time complexity to O(n).

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Optimizing Heuristics is Proposed for Reconstructing Data in Ultra High Voltage Direct Current Control and Protection System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper presents a heuristic approach grounded in gradient penalty optimization for enhancing Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network (WGAN) performance in mitigating the challenges associated with real-time data acquisition deficits within Ultra High Voltage Direct Current (UHVDC) control and protection systems. Through iterative training of the generator and discriminator components, the synthesized data can accurately conform to the intricate distribution patterns inherent in the original dataset. Incorporating gradient penalty serves to enforce Lipschitz continuity within the discriminator, thereby augmenting the training stability and efficacy of the model. The method proposed herein demonstrates favorable outcomes across varying degrees of data loss, spanning from 5% to 40%. Particularly notable is its proficiency in data reconstruction under a 40% data loss scenario, surpassing alternative methodologies.

articleTitle: Research and Development of Test Model Platform Based on Defect Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the equipment, the scale and complexity of software are increasing. Software defect testing has become the focus of software testing technology. How to carry out effective defect analysis is particularly important. In view of the characteristics of the equipment multi-task information control platform, the development of test model platform based on defect analysis is studied in the software construction stage. By repairing these defects, the number of defects in software products can be reduced, the product development cycle can be shortened, and the quality and reliability of software products can be effectively improved.

articleTitle: Predicting Cardiovascular Risk with Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Through the application of artificial intelligence and deep learning techniques, this paper presents an innovative approach to predict the risk of developing atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). We trained neural networks on a large dataset of electronic health records and risk factor data and evaluated their performance in predicting ASCVD risk in the next 10 years. Our results demonstrate that the neural networks achieved high accuracy, outperforming traditional risk prediction models. This approach has the potential to improve clinical decision-making in cardiovascular medicine and help clinicians develop more personalized treatment plans. Further research is needed to optimize the performance and generalizability of the neural network models for ASCVD risk prediction.

articleTitle: The Application of Blockchain Technology in Network Information Security
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet, the problem of network information security has become increasingly prominent. The traditional network security solutions have the weaknesses of centralization and vulnerability to attack, and cannot effectively deal with the risk of attack and data tampering. As a decentralized and tamper-resistant distributed ledger technology, blockchain technology has a good potential to be applied to network information security protection. This paper aims to summarize the basic principle and security characteristics of blockchain technology, discuss the network information security protection method based on blockchain, and analyze the application of blockchain technology in identity protection, food supply chain, O2O catering and other aspects for reference.

articleTitle: A Multi-Source Heterogeneous Information Sensing Method for Distribution Facilities in Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: A multi-source heterogeneous information perception method for power distribution facilities in communities is designed. It involves the collection of information about these facilities. This collection is accomplished using an improved YOLOv5 method. This method also includes the analysis of the correlation characteristics of information for distribution facilities. This analysis is conducted using the FP-Growth algorithm. The perception and recognition of multi-source heterogeneous anomaly information in distribution facilities are finally achieved. This is done through the extraction of features. This paper integrates data from different sources, which helps to improve the perception coverage rate. It also enhances the accuracy of data anomaly recognition in communities. In addition, this paper provides strong data support for accurate facility management and optimization decision-making. It effectively solves the problem of information perception of power distribution facilities in communities. This solution helps to build a more accurate anomaly detection model. Through feature extraction, the difference between normal and abnormal modes is identified. This identification enhances the information perception ability of power distribution facilities in communities. As a result, the perception and recognition of abnormal information are realized. Ultimately, the coverage of information perception for distribution facilities exceeds 90%, and achieves a precision of over 95% in identifying abnormal information related to community distribution facilities.

articleTitle: A Low SNR Wideband Spectrum Sensing Model Based on Multi-Label Learning Algorithms and Frequency Correlation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous innovation of wireless communication systems and the growing demand for wireless applications, there is an increasing need for wideband transmission in complex scenarios for 6G. Hence, in order to address practical challenges, it has become imperative to conduct wideband spectrum sensing under low SNR environments. Machine learning techniques have been swiftly incorporated into cognitive radio (CR) systems, aiming to effectively tackle these issues. Motivated by the correlation attribute among frequency points of each signal in the wideband spectrum, this paper presented a wideband spectrum sensing model utilizing frequency correlation and multi-label learning algorithms, namely FCML. Specifically, by deriving the frequency correlation between spectrum and drawing inspiration from the label correlation in multi-label learning algorithms, frequency correlation and label correlation are jointly modeled to extract relevant features from wideband spectrum for multi-label classification task learning, thus achieving detect primary user (PU) signals in completely blind wideband spectrum data. The simulation results demonstrate that the FCML has better performance than other algorithms under low SNR scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network-Assisted Input Optimization in Control System Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The development of automatic guided vehicles is the most important research topic. Deep learning has become increasingly important in the field of automatic control in recent years. In general, deep learning is used to tune controller parameters for better optimization. Control system designers still have to process sensor data and input reasonable control quantities. The paper presents an analysis of the characteristics of a single inductor and adopts manual data fusion methods, network regression effects, and embedded neural network deployment environments while applying the neural network model to the input link of the automatic control system. In this experiment, low-cost inductor array data is regressed to the lateral deviation provided by the image processing algorithm through a neural network model. The neural network model can effectively replace manual methods to process low-cost multidimensional sensor data, thereby reducing the time required to design automatic control systems.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Division of Parenting Beliefs Based on Neural Network Analysis of Complex Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to predict and intervene the irrational parenting beliefs of mothers with parenting stress, this paper proposes an innovative simulation method based on neural network technology to improve the prediction accuracy. This study first introduced the factors affecting parenting beliefs in detail, and automatically learned the underlying rules through neural network technology [6]. Specifically, this study adopts the neural network architecture combined with LSTM[7] and GCN[8]. Through learning complex historical data, the model can automatically learn the characteristic information of parenting beliefs in different complex situations according to historical data, and put the connection information formed by different parenting data into GCN for accurate classification according to the final embedding learned. Various experiments show that our method has good accuracy and feasibility.

articleTitle: Research on Building Urban Safety Emergency Response System by Computer Artificial Intelligence Automatic Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization and the increasing complexity of social risks, the construction of efficient and intelligent urban safety emergency response system has become a hotspot of current research. This paper discusses how to use computer technology, artificial intelligence and automatic control technology to construct this system. This paper reviews the relevant research background, points out the shortcomings of traditional emergency response systems, and emphasizes the importance of using advanced technologies to improve emergency response capabilities. This paper introduces a VAV -based urban emergency rescue decision support system model in detail. The model uses VAV as hardware carrier, combined with Microsoft Visual Studio 2010 and Microsoft SQL Server 2005 software platform to build a complete system architecture. Through the integration of geographic information system (GIS), VAV remote sensing technology, image recognition and other innovative technologies, the rapid acquisition and processing of accident site information, the formulation and evaluation of rescue plans, and the auxiliary management of rescue decisions are realized. The VA V -based urban emergency rescue decision support system model proposed in this paper has significant practical value and broad application prospects. Through research and practice, this paper successfully constructs a set of urban safety emergency response system model based on computer technology, artificial intelligence and automatic control technology. The computer model system not only improves the efficiency and accuracy of emergency response, but also provides scientific decision support for decision makers. The research results of this paper are of great significance for improving the level of urban safety emergency management and ensuring public safety.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Terminal System of Digital Cultural Tourism Sharing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This system is based on the hierarchical architecture of Redux, takes Vue-eli as the scaffolding, combines Spring Boot micro-architecture and Docker program container to complete the two-dimensional code recognition and integration. This project intends to study the multiple similarity model based on attention network. The traditional algorithms based on similarity measure have some problems, such as incomplete information, missing useful information and imprecise problem matching. This project explores taking the answer data as additional information and using expressions of various similarity degrees to extract corresponding semantic information from each dimension of the question. This increases the degree of correlation between semantics.

articleTitle: Component Analysis and Classification Study of Glassware Based on Random Forest and Decision Tree Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of compositional analysis and type identification of ancient glass artifacts and establishes a decision tree classification model based on the basic characteristics and chemical composition content of glass artifacts. Firstly, the correlation between surface weathering and glass properties was analyzed by filling the plurality of missing information and Spearman's correlation coefficient method; secondly, the sensitivity of lead-barium and high-potassium compositional data was analyzed by mechanical learning classification using SPSSPRO software, and the data was accurately classified by the decision tree model; lastly, the weathering coded data was used by Randomforest method to prediction, and the sensitivity of the model was analyzed. In addition, the chemical compositions of different glass types were differentially analyzed by Spearman's correlation coefficient and Mann-Whitney test. This study provides a new methodology for the classification and identification of ancient glass artifacts and contributes a new perspective to the conservation and research of cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Research and Optimization of Key Preparation Process Parameters of Magnetic Sensitive Components
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of magnetic sensors, current sensors based on magnetoresistive effect are expected to become effective tools to support the development of smart grids in the future because of their comprehensive advantages such as small size, high sensitivity, high precision, wide measurement range, high integration, and low cost. In order to meet the application requirements of different scenarios, the process of magnetically sensitive components in the preparation process will be different, this paper aims at the preparation of thin films with magnetic layer and barrier layer of magnetic tunnel junction, and tests and analyzes the influence of key parameters such as vacuum, air pressure, temperature, power, annealing conditions and other key parameters on the TMR ratio and magnetoelectric response of magnetoresistance unit in the preparation process. Main parameters of TMR and magnetron sputtering, and dependence of vacuum annealing conditions lays the foundation for obtaining a high TMR ratio and realizing the high-sensitivity magnetic sensor required for power application scenarios.

articleTitle: A multi-step knowledge reasoning model based on information enhanced graph representation and deep learning model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of low efficiency, high pressure and error prone caused by manual preparation of new equipment startup task, a multi-step knowledge reasoning model based on information enhanced graph representation and deep learning model is presented. The proposed methodology firstly generates the historical behavior sequences from the historical cases. Then, a scheduling behavior structure diagram is built based on joint behavior statistics data, and a large number of walking behavior sequences are generated using random walk strategy. Finally, these walking behavior sequences are encoded and used for training the knowledge reasoning model based on deep learning. By simulating the intelligent generation of new equipment startup steps in a provincial power grid through case reasoning, the effectiveness of model is verified, which provides a technical foundation for intelligent electric system.

articleTitle: Integrated Graph and Model Management of Main Distribution Network Based on Workflow and Graph Database
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, due to the continuous expansion of power grid equipment scale, multi-level coordination and interconnection of equipment management, as well as the need for real-time scheduling of the power grid. The integrated graph and model management of main and distribution network to support operation scheduling has become one of the bottlenecks in the development of smart grid. In this paper, we define a workflow model and a power grid graph data model firstly. Then, an integrated main distribution graph and model management architecture is designed, and finally we implement a stock and incremental main distribution graph and model data management system based on workflow and graph database. The experiment on real power data shows that the management method proposed in the paper can greatly improve the efficiency of graph management and meet the practical needs of power grid business requirement and analysis.

articleTitle: Optimization of Active Layer Morphology for High-Efficiency Layer-by-Layer Organic Solar Cells with 18.13% Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The production of organic solar cells (OSCs) employing the layer-by-layer (LbL) casting approach is a very popular method nowadays. However, the diffusion of the acceptor during the LbL film formation process is uncontrollable and limited, which restricts the development of the LbL OSCs performance. To surmount this phenomenon, a novel LbL deposition strategy was adopted in this study. Traces of PY-IT were firstly added to the donor layer DIS-CI to utilize the poor miscibility between the two polymeric materials, which resulted in a blend film with a large phase separation. Subsequently, owing to the favorable miscibility of PY-IT with the acceptor layer material LS-BO, as well as the large phase separation of the DIS-CI:PY-IT film, the diffusion of LS-BO in the donor layer was effectively expanded. This induced a more desirable vertical morphology of active layer, thereby better balancing the charge generation, transport, and collection. For this reason, LbL OSCs based on DIS-CI:PY-IT/LS-BO achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of IS.13<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which is a dramatic improvement versus the device based on DIS-CI/LS-BO (PCE of 17.16%). This study presents a novel and efficacious strategy for building efficient LbL OSCs.

articleTitle: Application Research of Frequency Conversion Control and Energy Saving Technology for Intelligent Networked New Energy Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of permanent magnet synchronous motors and control fields, high power density and high control accuracy will become the main development direction in the automotive field. In this paper, a new motor drive control system based on digital signal processing is proposed. The decoupled processing of the system is emphasized, and its main function modules are described in detail. Combined with the characteristics of TIDSP, reasonable coupling of software and hardware is carried out to realize the control of small size, multi-function, high efficiency and high reliability. The practical application proves that the design of the system is reasonable, the work is reliable, and the technical index of the city bus is satisfied. In the aspect of control algorithm, because of its advantages of small steady-state error, high reliability, simple algorithm, etc., it is more and more used in high energy efficiency and high precision permanent magnet synchronous motor. The system can also display the current and voltage of the DC bus.

articleTitle: Detection Algorithm of Laboratory Abnormal Behavior Based on Two-stream Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The application of intelligent video surveillance systems can reduce the workload of workers, save human resources, and timely handle abnormal situations, reducing losses. Based on intelligent monitoring systems, research on laboratory abnormal behavior detection algorithms uses dual stream convolutional neural networks to provide security for laboratories. We need to integrate RGB images and optical flow images, and use residual structure dual flow network fusion for comparative analysis. The spatial flow channel obtains appearance information such as texture, contour, and points of interest in a single frame RGB image, while the temporal flow channel obtains motion information in optical flow images. The residual structure effectively overcomes the gradient explosion caused by deepening the network layer, prevents network degradation, uses Dropout to prevent overfitting, transfers learning and fine tunes network parameters to improve the network's generalization performance and feature acquisition ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Design and Performance Optimization of Intelligent Traffic Signal Control System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet of Things technology, intelligent traffic signal control systems have become an excellent way to improve traffic efficiency and safety. In this paper, we model an intelligent traffic signal control system based on the basic theory of the Internet of Things. It introduces a graph neural network and principal component analysis for performance optimization. Numerical examples include the relationship between the traffic flow prediction or signal control results in the sample library and the traffic flows, the relationship with devices in the Internet of Things, the relationship with graph neural networks, and the relationship with principal component analysis error. It turns out that an intelligent traffic signal control system based on the Internet of Things can more accurately predict traffic flow and optimize signal control using graph neural networks and principal component analysis. It works with the Internet of Things to realize intelligent traffic management. In this paper, we use theoretical analysis to elucidate the system's internal mechanisms and provide scientific support for further improving the quality of transportation systems and meeting users' expectations.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Simple Non-contact Temperature Measurement and Identification Device
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the advent of the post-epidemic era, more and more people realize the importance of working without contact. This paper designs a simple non-contact temperature measurement and identification device, which has application value in public places such as rail transit station and campus community. This design device takes STM32F103 and STM32F407 chips as the core processors, supplemented by related peripheral circuits, to conduct contactless temperature measurement and identification. It combines contactless temperature measurement and face recognition technology, which can achieve contactless temperature measurement, threshold adjustment, face recognition, beyond the threshold can automatically alarm and other functions. Compared with the current fixed identification device in the station, this design has the advantages of mobile, portable, complete information collection, high intelligence, and wide range of applicable scenarios.

articleTitle: Streamlining Navigation: Depth-Informed Item Mapping for Enhanced Home Service Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In response to the growing demand for efficient home service robots, this paper introduces a novel method for enhancing robotic navigation by accurately mapping specific items within the robot's environment. Utilizing the robot's current position and depth information, the proposed approach calculates the location of items on a predefined map, offering a streamlined alternative to existing methods. By simplifying the mapping process, this technique significantly improves the robot's ability to navigate complex environments, making it a valuable tool for the development of more intuitive and effective home service robots.

articleTitle: From Data to Decisions: Tailoring Deep Learning Model Features for Individual Financial Strategies in Bitcoin Market
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the increasing use of deep learning models in financial time series analysis, customizing models for specific users has become a cutting-edge research topic. This research establishes a deep learning model and feature set customization recommendation method, achieving the best match between feature engineering technology and personal investment risk preferences. This model takes into account different initial fund sizes and different feature configurations, uses multiple deep learning models to simulate transactions, and records econometric indicators, trading processes and results to develop personalized models and feature sets suggestion.

articleTitle: Research on Power Marketing Business Analysis System Based on Short-Term Load Forecasting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of highly automated artificial intelligence technology and software, information and digital technologies are reconstructing the original business model of traditional enterprises. The Internet plus power marketing construction of power grid companies has brought about a large-scale transformation and upgrading of marketing services. The daily business development of power grid companies cannot be separated from the marketing business system, electricity collection system, inspection system, power supply service dispatching platform and other systems. There are many business systems, some of which have a long service life and are often unable to update and respond to new business demands in time. Based on the short-term load forecasting algorithm, this paper makes the marketing business system serve for other business applications and response. It is helpful for power grid companies to formulate the market power purchase in the past few days and provide technical support for power grid companies' strategy of purchasing and selling electricity.

articleTitle: BERT-Lattice-LSTM-Based Entity Recognition for Electric Power Safety Hazards
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Addressing the challenge of delineating the boundaries of domain-specific terms in text entity recognition of electric power safety hazards, this paper introduces an entity recognition model for electric power safety hazards based on BERT-Lattice-LSTM. Firstly, the words after word separation are input into BERT model for training, and the words are input into Word2vec (word to vector) model for training. Subsequently, the trained word and phrase vectors are fed into a bidirectional long short-term memory network (LSTM) model with a lattice structure, enabling the recognition of entities within incoming texts related to electric power hidden dangers. Comparison experiments show that the entity recognition model based on BERT-Lattice-LSTM proposed in this paper for electric power safety hazards achieves good results. The achieved accuracy rate, standing at 83.23%, outperforms other models, demonstrating its superiority.

Author Keywords: bi-directional long and short-term memory networks

articleTitle: Intelligent Health Monitoring Device and Technology in Wireless Community Remote Medical Monitoring System on Basis of ZigBee Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Currently, the demand for community health monitoring is increasing, and traditional monitoring equipment can no longer meet the requirements of remote monitoring. This article studied an intelligent health monitoring device (IHMD) in a wireless community remote medical monitoring system (RMMS) based on ZigBee network. Based on the inherent characteristics of community monitoring networks, this paper explored a CZR (Congestion Control ZigBee Routing) algorithm suitable for community monitoring networks through the study of ZigBee routing algorithm. In the hardware design of the system, the gateway module monitors and manages the entire community monitoring network, integrates and processes the received physiological data, and finally uploads it to the Internet. The main function of this module is to transmit physiological data through the ZigBee network protocol and TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol) protocol, serving as a bridge. This article evaluated the user effectiveness of the device by collecting evaluations and feedback from community residents on the device. User ID 001 had a first-time usage experience, with a usability score of 4, reliability score of 5, and comfort score of 4. The establishment of a community health monitoring system in this article is an effective method that is conducive to promoting nationwide health monitoring.

Author Keywords: Wireless Community Remote Medical Monitoring System

articleTitle: Research on Genetic Algorithm of Network Search under Computer Artificial Intelligence Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this paper, an improved genetic simulated annealing algorithm (SAGA) for wireless sensor networks is studied and designed. The aim of this project is to better study the optimal transmission path in wireless sensor networks (WSN s) based on inter-node communication and reduce node energy consumption. Firstly, the model is built based on the optimal control index. Then the fitness function, cross operation and variation operation in the evolutionary process are studied. The routing calculation and genetic evolution calculation are carried out at the same time until the approximate optimal path is found. This method can solve the traditional local optimization problem well. Then the Metropolis criterion is given to make the jump variable in the simulated annealing algorithm have some regularity. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can effectively solve the problem of wireless sensor path optimization. Compared with the existing methods, the proposed method not only saves a lot of energy, but also saves a lot of calculation time.

articleTitle: Investigating and Applying Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing with Index Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing with Index Modulation (OFDM-IM) has emerged as a remarkable modulation technique, combining OFDM and index modulation to achieve high spectral efficiency in wireless communication. Its application spans various fields, including advanced 5G technology, synchronous wireless information, and non-orthogonal multiple access technology. This study explores OFDM-IM, analyzing its theories, system properties, applications, and challenges. Initially, we define and explore OFDM and OFDM-IM systems, focusing on their components and operating principles. Following this, we delve into two analytical approaches for the OFDM-IM system - mathematical and simulation analysis. Our findings reveal that the OFDM-IM system surpasses the basic OFDM system in bit error rate performance and frequency offset resistance. We also discuss recent applications of OFDM-IM, including its use in energy-efficient 5G networks and millimeter wave communication. In understanding these systems' challenges, we highlight potential future optimizations, such as the integration of OFDM-IM with deep learning and Permutation-mode OFDM-IM. Finally, we summarize our research and acknowledge its limitations. This work provides a comprehensive overview and future direction for the study of OFDM-IM systems.

articleTitle: Enhancing Hydropower Generation Forecasting in Southwest China Through Deep Learning-Based Multimodal Data Fusion Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This study aims to significantly enhance the accuracy of hydropower generation forecasting in Southwest China through the integration of deep learning and blockchain technologies. The core innovation of the research lies in the development of a deep learning-based multimodal data fusion model. This model effectively integrates data from multiple sources including meteorological, hydrological, and power demand, and significantly improves the performance of the forecasting model through advanced feature extraction and fusion capabilities. Furthermore, to enhance data security and consistency, this study introduces blockchain technology into the field of hydropower generation forecasting for the first time, proposing a mechanism for real-time data verification and sharing. Comprehensive experimental analyses were conducted using the rich data from the “Chinese Hydropower Database”. The results demonstrate significant improvements in key performance indicators of our model compared to traditional methods. Through this research, we provide not only an innovative computational model for hydropower generation forecasting but also valuable insights and practical methodologies for solving complex energy problems using advanced computing technologies.

articleTitle: Dissecting and Implementing SOYA Algorithm Variations in Convolutional and Turbo Code Decoding: An Analytical Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Turbo coding, a forward error correction code scheme, was introduced by Berrou and Glavieux at the 1993 ICC International Conference. It is widely used in various fields of communication, including mobile communication, image and video transmission, and deep space communication. Notably, it was the first code to approach the Shannon limit. However, the traditional Viterbi algorithm, which calculates the maximum likelihood (ML) sequence of convolutional code for decoding, provides only a hard output judgement, thereby losing information in a cascading system. This paper pivots from the Viterbi algorithm to derive the reliability information within the turbo decoder, which when combined with the Viterbi algorithm, produces a soft output - also known as the Soft Output Viterbi Algorithm (SOVA). This work also touches upon a simplified SOYA. Although this version leads to a slight performance degradation (0.4 dB), it offers the advantage of simplicity, making it an attractive choice for certain applications. The SOYA algorithm builds upon the traditional Viterbi algorithm and enhances it through soft output. This evolution holds substantial importance for 3G communication systems and related fields.

articleTitle: Integration of Force-Torque Information into Reinforcement Learning for Accurate Position Estimation Using the TD3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Robotic manipulation tasks often require precise position estimation, a crucial aspect for successful task completion. In this study, we propose a novel approach to enhance such position estimation by integrating force-torque information into the reinforcement learning (RL) framework. Unlike conventional methods that heavily rely on visual data, our approach focuses exclusively on leveraging force-torque data. Specifically, we utilize the Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm, known for its effectiveness in RL tasks. By incorporating force-torque feedback, our method offers a promising alternative for achieving accurate position estimation in robotic tasks, especially in scenarios where visual data may be limited or unreliable. To evaluate the effectiveness of the RL-based positioning strategy, the experiment is conducted using a simulation environment. The Mujoco physics engine is employed to simulate the peg-in-hole assembly task and assess the performance of the learned control policy.

articleTitle: Structural Design Key Points and Stability Analysis of Shipborne Self-Stabilizing Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: When ships operate at sea, they are susceptible to the influence of complex sea conditions, leading to phenomena such as rolling and pitching. Among the six degrees of freedom of a ship, heave, roll, and pitch have the most significant impact on the normal operation of shipborne equipment and require compensation through a stabilizing platform. In this paper, a three-degree-of-freedom shipborne stabilizing platform is proposed to address the challenges posed by dynamic uncertainties and unknown external disturbances. It treats the dynamic uncertainties, unknown external disturbances, and the coupling between the platform's degrees of freedom as total disturbances. An Extended State Observer (ESO) is utilized to estimate the total disturbances in real-time. Based on this, a control law for the shipborne stabilizing platform is designed using Active Disturbance Rejection Control (ADRC). The effectiveness of the proposed shipborne stabilizing platform is verified through simulation experiments.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Identification System for Reusable Cigarette Boxes Based on OCR Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The feature recognition of cigarette box identification codes is of great significance in avoiding packaging errors of cigarette products. This article designs an automatic recognition system for cigarette box identification codes based on optical character recognition (OCR) technology, which can achieve brand recognition of old cardboard boxes. The system consists of industrial cameras, light sources, industrial control computers, etc. After capturing the image of the cigarette box with an industrial camera, the OCR algorithm is used to identify the identification code in the image and compare it with the brand information in the product library to determine whether the cigarette box is abnormal. The application results show that the recognition accuracy of reused cardboard boxes with blurred identification is 98.9%, which can significantly improve the reuse rate of old cardboard boxes.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Real-Time Simulation Model Based on Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of e-commerce and the progress of science and technology, the logistics system needs to develop and progress. Traditional manual logistics has low efficiency, high cost, and is prone to mistakes. Efficient logistics system is playing an increasingly important role in enhancing the economy, and the use of computer simulation technology to optimize the logistics system has become a popular research field. The paper first analyzes the computer simulation technology and the logistics system, then establishes the logistics simulation model and studies the real-time simulation algorithm of the logistics system, and uses the partial particle swarm algorithm to find the optimal solution, and finally verifies its rationality.

articleTitle: Turbo Decoding Theory: Derivation and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Turbo codes are among the most effective error correction codes currently in use, providing outstanding performance and a vast array of applications. Even though Turbo codes have the theoretical capacity to approximate the limiting code rate of Shannon's theorem through iterations, the substantial computational complexity of the decoding process poses challenges for the optimization of Turbo codes performance in practical applications. Additionally, the computational delay hampers its use in communication systems that require low latency, such as mobile phones. This paper delves into the coding process of Turbo codes, scrutinizes the decoding concepts, and summarizes Soft Output Viterbi Algorithm, Maximum A Posteriori, and Logarithmic Maximum A Posteriori decoding methods through a systematic review approach. It also compares the decoding performance of these diverse methods considering parameters such as time delay, computational complexity, storage space, and Bit Error Rate. Through our analysis, we found that the Maximum A Posteriori algorithm is the most complex, the Logarithmic Maximum A Posteriori algorithm is somewhat simplified in comparison, and the Soft Output Viterbi Algorithm possesses the least computational complexity. Regarding decoding performance, the Maximum A Posteriori algorithm has the lowest Bit Error Rate, followed by the Logarithmic Maximum A Posteriori algorithm, with the Soft Output Viterbi Algorithm performing the worst. This study provides valuable insights into the key factors for enhancing the performance of Turbo codes from a theoretical perspective. It holds substantial significance for the practical application and future development of Turbo codes.

articleTitle: Testing Method for Full-Space Phased Array Telemetry and Control System Indices Based on Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes an automated testing method for a phased array telemetry and control system index based on an unmanned aerial vehicle (VAV) platform, specifically for a hemispherical conformal full-space phased array antenna. After determining the beam coverage, VAV traversal points are designed, and then the receive quality factor (G/T value) and equivalent isotropically radiated power (EIRP value) of the full-space phased array telemetry and control system are tested respectively. The advantages of this automated testing method include: no need for complex infrastructure, making it suitable for field testing needs, reducing testing costs; achieving automated testing of the full-space phased array telemetry and control system index, simplifying the operation process compared to traditional schemes, reducing testing difficulty, and improving testing efficiency and accuracy; and by controlling the VAV flight trajectory, the phased array system index can be automatically tested. Finally, the test results are stored according to the beam pointing angle, preparing for subsequent experimental tasks.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Self-Damping Characteristics of Conductors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The self-damping power of the transmission conductor refers to the power that the conductor dissipates internally during its vibration. The self-damping primarily results from energy dissipation due to friction between individual strands of the conductor, followed by material hysteresis damping. Its value indicates the conductor's capacity to absorb vibration energy. The magnitude of the self-damping power is directly associated with the transmission conductor's vibration level, with higher self-damping power contributing to more effective vibration control of the conductor. To determine the installation of a vibration control device for the transmission line, the self-damping power of the transmission conductor is needed to be calculated. Therefore, in this paper, the self-damping power was analyzed theoretically. The calculation model of the self-damping power was proposed, and the equations for parameters were given. Finally, the accuracy of the model was verified by comparing to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Safety Computation of Automobile Industry Based on DEA Model and Computer Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The automobile industry holds a very important position in the industrial structure of our country. This paper calculates the key coefficients of automobile industry safety in recent years based on the DEA basic model and computer simulation technology. Firstly, the paper constructs an influence index model based on the key factors affecting automobile engineering technology in our country. Then, based on the characteristics of the index model, an A-DEA mathematical model is constructed. Next, by utilizing computer simulation technology and controlling the step size method, the paper calculates the important influencing factors and the magnitude of these factors on China's automobile industry. Finally, the paper concludes that the method of calculating automobile industry safety based on the DEA model and computer simulation technology can calculate the safety coefficient results of the automobile industry in real time and accurately, providing assurance for the safety of the automobile industry in our country.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Motor-Operated Valve Testing System for In-Core Instrumentation System CPR Nuclear Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: RIC is abbreviated as In-core instrumentation system of nuclear power plant. The system is used for In-core neutron measurement. Motor-operated valve testing system is designed to test the function and performance of RIC Motor-operated valve. The testing system plays an important role in the daily maintenance work. In this paper, the Motor-operated valve testing system is designed based on PLC and electronic technology. Through hardware and software design and testing after design, the testing system has been proven to meet the requirements of the technical specification. Modular design of the testing system architecture, each module is independent of each other; this is beneficial for expansion and maintenance.

articleTitle: Modal Simulation in Conductors Based on Finite Difference Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aeolian vibrations in conductors are among the most prevalent issues encountered in overhead transmission lines. These vibrations are distinguished by their high frequency, low amplitude, and prolonged duration. Given that wind is a constant presence in the natural environment, the phenomenon of aeolian vibrations in conductors is an ongoing concern. The prolonged vibrations in conductors lead to a cumulative effect that can cause fatigue damage to the conductors, their anti-vibration devices, and associated fittings, thus impacting the secure and stable operation of the power grid. In this paper, a simplified mechanical model for conductors has been developed, ensuring that it does not markedly impact the results of the conductor vibration research. A partial differential equation describing the conductor vibrations under steady-state conditions has been formulated. By incorporating dimensionless parameters, this partial differential equation is transformed into an ordinary differential equation. The equation is then resolved using the finite difference method, which facilitates the determination of the conductor's modal shapes and inherent frequencies. The results reveal that there is a minimal variation in the vibration frequencies among the conductor's lower-order modes. However, with the increase in mode order, the disparity in the inherent frequencies obtained by the two calculation methods grows more significant. Consequently, for more precise results, it is necessary to factor in the conductor's stiffness within the frequency range of aeolian vibrations.

articleTitle: Integrated Service System for Intelligent Community Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Intelligent community construction, as an important part of intelligent city construction, is an important direction of social development in various countries and a hot topic in the academic world. Blockchain technology is a natural fit with the needs of intelligent community construction based on its decentralization, non-tampering, open and transparent information, and other characteristics. This paper is oriented to the needs of intelligent community construction and proposes an intelligent community integrated service system based on blockchain technology, which includes key components such as Integrated information interaction system, public resource reservation system, Transaction management system and so on. Through this system, the intelligent community can improve the efficiency and quality of services, while ensuring the transparency and openness of information as well as safety and security. The proposal of the intelligent community integrated service system provides a new perspective for the theoretical research and practical application of intelligent communities and is of great practical significance for promoting the construction of intelligent cities and improving the quality of life of residents.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on UART Communication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article is a comprehensive research paper on the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter (UART) communication protocol, aiming to familiarize relevant personnel with the principles and applications of the Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter protocol and contribute to the further development of UART research. UART is the most fundamental communication protocol in digital communication. After continuous research and improvement by scientists such as Gordon Bell, it still has its unique value and is widely used in various fields such as the Internet of Things, industrial control, and healthcare. In the second chapter of this article, the basic principles section introduces the hardware structure of UART and the implementation method of UART communication protocol. The hardware structure of UART includes a UART transmitter, UART receiver, baud rate generator, and control circuit. The UART communication protocol relies on transmitting data frames, which include start bits, data bits, parity bits, and stop bits. At the same time, this article also analyzes the advantages and current challenges of UART. In the third chapter of this article, some typical research achievements based on UART by modern scientists are listed and their research value is analyzed. I believe that with the development of digital technology in the future, the UART protocol can be integrated into more microprocessors to obtain more efficient communication methods and achieve greater value.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Strategy and Stability of a Modular Multilevel Converter in an AC-DC Hybrid Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: AC and DC hybrid power grids are widely used in the power industry due to the continuous development of energy systems. In this paper, the control strategy and stability analysis of MMC (Modular Multilevel Converter) in AC / DC hybrid power grid are studied. First, the network model of the AC-DC hybrid power grid and the protocol specification of MMC are introduced. Secondly, the fuzzy logic controller is designed and implemented based on the performance evaluation, stability analysis, and dynamic response analysis of the MMC. Further, the experimental results of the MMC are evaluated and analyzed using the experimental platform and experimental scheme. At the end of this paper, a summary of the research results is presented, and conclusions are derived regarding MMC control, which is considered to provide a useful reference for the design of AC and DC hybrid power grid stability and control systems.

articleTitle: Design and Application of New Technology for Intelligent Inspection and Early Warning of Submarine Cables against External Breakage
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Submarine cables, as crucial equipment in marine power transmission projects connecting island power supplies, bear significant digital communication tasks. However, cables laid on the seabed are easily susceptible to natural or human-induced damages. The most significant threats to currently laid submarine cables are ship anchor operations and the use of fishing gear by the marine fishing industry. Anchor damage, a type of external breakage, accounts for over 70% of submarine cable faults and is a major factor in the frequent occurrence of cable faults. Due to varying burial depths, submarine cables incur considerable maintenance costs and have long repair cycles, impacting island power supply, limiting local production activities, and resulting in substantial economic losses and social impacts. Therefore, to ensure the safe operation of submarine cables, the development of ship anchor identification and early warning technology is imperative. Based on this, this paper starts with the external breakage factors of anchor damage, establishing a submarine cable anti-external breakage intelligent inspection and early warning monitoring platform through 3D visualization technology and AIS equipment. This platform can visualize the relationship between the submarine topography, ship anchors, and cables through 3D technology, providing comprehensive and multidimensional support for early warning judgment and incident playback accountability in submarine cable operation and maintenance, thereby further reducing cable faults caused by anchor damage and consequent economic losses.

articleTitle: Application of an improved genetic algorithm fuzzy PID control algorithm for greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of nonlinearity, time-varying and hysteresis of greenhouse environmental factors, it is proposed a fuzzy PID control algorithm which is optimized according to the revised heredity algorithm. According to the commonly used intelligent control method of greenhouse, the enhanced hereditary operation algorithm was adopted to optimize the fuzzy control, which effectively solves the shortcomings of fuzzy PID over-reliance on expert experience and lack of dynamics. Through the simulation of greenhouse environment temperature, the feasibility of the proposed modified inherited algorithm to oxidize fuzzy PID algorithm was verified. The maximum deviation of the algorithm is 1.2%, and the response time is 826s, which is far less than the traditional control method. It has produced favourable outcome in terms of greenhouse monitoring, which has improved the level of greenhouse monitoring.

articleTitle: Blind Estimation Method of WCDMA Signal Spreading Code
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Based on an in-depth study of the OVSF (Orthogonal Variable Spread Factor) code utilized in the WCDMA (Wideband Code Division Multiple Access) communication system, which includes the recursive code construction principle, code tree structure, and mathematical theory, a blind estimation method for OVSF is introduced. This method is based on OVSF code tree search and utilizes symbols near-zero rates after despreading to distinguish the ambiguity of despreading. The simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm is effective for OVSF code estimation in WCDMA communication systems under low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and adapts to the condition of multiple users in WCDMA downlink, which has high engineering application value.

articleTitle: A method for detecting false data attacks in smart grid based on k-means
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: False data injection attacks (FDI as) have become the most harmful attack means in smart grid. On this basis, this paper adopts the concept of “node voltage stability index”, and analyzes the influence of FDI as (false data injection attacks) on network node NVSI (Node Voltage Stability Index), and establishes the relationship between them. On this basis, K-means+ clustering algorithm based on CFPSO (constraint factor particle swarm optimization) optimization is used to cluster the nodes in the network and identify the weak links in the network. This project intends to study the vulnerability detection algorithm based on SFD (State Forecasting Detection), and give priority to the detection of nodes with high vulnerability level. In the IEEE30-bus system with a small percentage of attacks, three methods (SFD detection method, conventional target detection method and maximum residual method) can detect few FDIAs; With the increase of the proportion of being attacked, the probability of being detected also increases. Under the condition that every system is detected, the detection rate of SFD can exceed 70%. This paper helps to ensure the safe operation of smart grid.

articleTitle: Design and Research on Integrated Intelligent Monitoring and Early Warning Technology for Submarine Cables
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of the marine economy has led to an increase in various trans-oceanic power and communication cable projects. Ensuring the operational safety of these submarine cables has become a crucial task for their construction units. However, the organizational structure of submarine cables and the complexity of the seabed environment where they are laid make them vulnerable to various factors, leading to failures or damage. Historical data indicates that submarine cables are mainly at risk from three types of damage: degradation of insulation due to seawater erosion and scouring, seabed risks including seabed movement and ocean currents, and human-induced risks like damage from ship anchors, leading to cable breaks. These risks have led to frequent incidents like offshore wind farm shutdowns and large-scale power outages on islands, resulting in significant economic losses. Given the instability and complexity of the submarine cable environment, this paper has developed an integrated monitoring and early warning platform to further realize intelligent monitoring and early warning for submarine cables. This platform combines technologies like radar, AIS, and CCTV video to form an integrated intelligent monitoring system for data collection and risk warning for submarine cables. Simulation tests show that the system can effectively provide early warnings for ship anchoring and grounding, and can observe disturbances to submarine cables, demonstrating its feasibility.

Author Keywords: Intelligent monitoring and early warning technology

articleTitle: Weather Forecast Model Based on Decision Tree and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper is dedicated to weather prediction by establishing two models, the decision tree ID3 algorithm and the BP neural network algorithm, and analyzing the contingency and inevitability of summer wildfires in Chongqing. The decision tree ID3 algorithm uses information entropy for feature selection and builds a tree model. The BP neural network algorithm adjusts weights and biases through forward propagation and back propagation for prediction. First, the establishment steps of the two models are described, including information gain calculation and recursive construction of decision trees, as well as forward propagation and back propagation in BP neural networks. Secondly, this paper uses BP neural network to predict the weather in August. Finally, meteorological data were used to verify the model; the ID3 algorithm was used to analyze the contingency and inevitability of wildfires.

articleTitle: A Neural Network Data Set Regression Prediction Algorithm Based on K-means
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Among the high-dimensional data regression analysis and prediction model in the research of smart grid, traditional statistical models cannot balance information values between different dimensions, which has an impact on prediction validity of the data set. In order to solve this problem, a neural network data set regression prediction algorithm based on K-means is proposed. First, at the feature level, multi-layer recurrent neural network (RNN) extract data features of different dimensions and train responses. Then, at the algorithm level, classifier model of K-means is used to classify and fuse feature responses of the RNN according to the dimensional characteristics of the data. Subsequently, the combination forecasting model is constructed for the data set of output response, thereby improving the reliability of the prediction algorithm. The test was carried out on the public regression data set. The experimental results showed that the mean absolute error was reduced by 14.45% compared with Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU).

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization of Substation Reactive Voltage Control Based on Electronic Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Substation reactive voltage control has entered a phase of high-quality development as the power system enters a new era. It is necessary to propose a reactive voltage control proposition that better meets the power grid's voltage stability and reliability, focusing on the intelligent idea of adhering to the electronic transformer as the core. Based on the dynamic evolution of electronic transformer development, the theoretical analysis framework of the substation reactive voltage control system is constructed according to the internal logic of reactive voltage control, which can explain the reactive voltage control strategy optimization mechanism jointly generated by the reactive voltage control mechanism of electronic transformer and adaptive neural network and the principal component analysis cycle mechanism. The possibility of moving towards the high-quality development goal of reactive voltage control in substations will be explored continually from the perspective of technical change and practical deduction of reactive voltage control. Substation reactive voltage control is designed to ensure the power grid has a voltage quality that meets expected standards and is committed to continually improving voltage quality and enhancing grid reliability. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the reactive voltage control based on the internal circulation of the electronic transformer quality to construct the mechanism of interaction and feedback between the electronic transformer and voltage quality perception of the power grid, and establish the evaluation system of electronic transformer and reactive voltage control. In this way, the reactive voltage control strategy of the substation can be optimized, and the intelligent power system can be promoted to truly meet the power grid's needs.

articleTitle: Research on Product Lifetime Prediction Models Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article introduces the comparison between exploratory data analysis techniques and traditional experimental techniques. By adopting advanced data pattern recognition and utilizing data fitting and extrapolation methods, it avoids assuming a statistical distribution model for the data beforehand. This approach circumvents the potential inaccuracy in data analysis caused by incorrect model assumptions used in traditional experiments, reduces the time required for life testing and the number of test devices, and lowers the cost of testing. By combining exploratory data analysis techniques with product physical failure analysis, the article completes the construction of a life-related test system, sensitive parameter monitoring, data processing and model analysis, as well as the establishment of a life prediction model. The life prediction model is then validated, confirming its accuracy and effectiveness in guiding accurate assessments of a product's long-term operational and storage lifespan.

articleTitle: A Relational Triple Extraction Method Based on Cascading Pointer Annotation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: An improved BF-CASRE model has been proposed for the problem of overlapping relational triples, which is currently not addressed by existing relational extraction models. This model leverages a function for relational modeling, facilitating the mapping of subjects to objects within sentences to enhance the understanding of relationships between entities. It encodes contextual information through a pre-trained Bert model. Next, subject and object taggers are implemented based on the pointer network for a specific relationship. Finally, the fusion self-attention mechanism is utilized to enhance the extraction of semantic features from the text by considering the importance of information at different positions within the text, thus improving overall effectiveness. In the feature fusion stage, a dense layer is added to fuse the CLS vector obtained by the Bert encoder and the subject information obtained by the subject tagger to improve the feature expression ability. Experimental validation of the BF-CASRE model was performed on the Chinese relational extraction dataset DuIE. The results showed that the improved BF-CASRE model effectively improves the performance of relational extraction.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Greenhouse Environment Monitoring and Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of society, people care much more about their food safety and food supply is becoming a pressing issue for every countries. So, greenhouse, an efficient and stable cultivation method, is prevailing. And to better help the greenhouse cultivation, scores of intelligent system is designed.
