Based on their works, we introduced a more efficient and comprehensive intelligent greenhouse monitoring and control system. As traditional intelligent system, we design CO2 concentration monitoring, temperature and humidity monitoring, soil moisture monitoring and light intensity monitoring. Compared to traditional greenhouse intelligent system, we introduce a control mechanism part through threshold and remote control part through APP to help farmers timely obtain the data of their greenhouses and take care of their greenhouses even if they are not in greenhouse. Moreover, it is low cost and easy to operate. And, its threshold and remote control part can be set by farmers, which means it is suitable for different kinds greenhouse. Most importantly, the system presented in this paper is suitable for applications in the agricultural sector.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Access Control Method for Power Grid Data Sharing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the ongoing advancement of the Internet of Things (IoT) and the daily accumulation of substantial data within systems, the implementation of access control emerges as a critical mechanism to safeguard data privacy and facilitate secure sharing. Traditional access control in storage systems is centralized, posing threats to user information security and data privacy. As blockchain is an emerging technology widely applied in the field of data privacy protection, this paper introduces a blockchain access control framework based on Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs). The paper combines blockchain technology with an identity access control solution based on distributed identity recognition applications. Additionally, it elaborately designs the interaction mechanism between DIDs and smart contracts. Finally, in our experiments, we construct a blockchain system based on the FISCO-BCOS project and assess throughput and access control efficiency. The results demonstrate the availability and effectiveness of this model.

articleTitle: Cooperation Among Multiple Medical Institutions on Retinal Disease Identification Based on Federated Learning and Unlearning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Due to the aging of the world's population, the incidence of retinal diseases is on the rise. Machine learning is expected to have a crucial role in identifying retinal disease. Multiple medical institutions cooperate on retinal disease identification using machine learning, which can effectively break down data silos, but it is often accompanied by privacy concerns. Federated learning (FL) solves the privacy problem in the process of collaborative model training, where data of each medical institution does not leave the local to avoid data leakage. With a series of privacy laws coming into place, it is critical to give medical institutions participating in FL training the right to be forgotten. Federated unlearning (FU) allows a medical institution requesting to exit the cooperation to eliminate its contribution from the global model. We simulate the scenarios of cooperation among multiple medical institutions on retinal disease identification, using data augmentation to deal with an imbalanced dataset and backdoor attacks to evaluate the effects of FU. Experimental results show that FL and FU have potential for application in cooperation among multiple medical institutions on retinal disease identification.

articleTitle: Research on Low Latency Virtual Reality Interaction Technology in Converged 5G Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This project will use various virtual reality software and hardware technologies to establish a set of realtime simulation system that can realize human-computer interaction. The purpose is to solve the shortcomings of virtual simulation technology in human-computer interaction, real-time response and data collection. The system can evaluate the product quality by measuring the user interface performance according to the relevant operating parameters obtained by the user in the human-machine interaction. Then the signal security detection method of network independent communication layer is proposed. The reconstruction of the 5G ecosystem architecture is realized through the reconfiguration of the isolation and control functions of the previous transmission. It improves the overall performance of individual communication networks. A method based on multi-scale wavelet packet matrix is proposed to detect the hidden anomaly flow. The disturbance threshold of the signal is obtained by analyzing the information of the signal with EMD. By detecting the sensitive information in the network, people can obtain the attacked information and realize effective identification. The method is proved to be feasible by practical engineering.

articleTitle: Optimizing Material Property Prediction Precision via Global-Local Dual-Path Feature Extraction in a Deep Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Thermal conductivity is a critical performance parameter for thermal barrier coating materials and a key thermal property. Shortening the cycle for predicting the thermal conductivity holds practical significance. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) serve as the basis for many current studies aimed at processing images to predict material properties. However, in general, CNNs are limited in their receptive field due to their fixed-size convolution kernels, making it difficult to simultaneously extract both local and global information from images. In this paper, we develop a novel Global-Local Dual-Path Feature Extraction network termed GloLo-net, capable of extracting both global and local features from images and accurately predicting thermal conductivity based on material image data. A newly designed multiscale attention fusion module can comprehensively capture visual features of the material's microstructure. Experiment results show the deep learning neural network outperforms many existing data-driven methods.

articleTitle: A Printer Security Protection Method Based on Trusted Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article analyzes the security issues of network printers within the State Grid system. A printer security protection method based on trusted computing technology has been proposed. This method integrates trusted security chips as trusted roots into PC motherboards, printer motherboards, and consumables motherboards, and utilizes identity authentication, security metrics, and password services of trusted computing technology to achieve security authentication and data encryption and decryption between printers, PCs, and consumables devices.

articleTitle: Design of Geographic Information System for Biodiversity Conservation Based on Computer Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Yunnan Province has taken a leading role in promoting an ecological civilization, particularly in the southwest region of China. The northwest area within Yunnan Province is especially crucial in driving forward the development of ecological civilization. This study utilized various advanced methodologies, such as the land use transfer matrix and center-of-gravity migration model, to deeply investigate the spatiotemporal evolution of ecologically essential land in northwest Yunnan and analyze the intricate factors that have influenced its path. This article seeks to design a geographical information system for biodiversity conversation based on computer technology. Remote Sensing and Geographic Information System are contemporary geospatial technologies that aid in the gathering of data for biodiversity conservation management and planning. Traditional approaches to collecting biodiversity data have been determined to be expensive and time-consuming. To this effect, this study seeks to design a geographical information system for biodiversity conservation based on computer technology.

articleTitle: Research on 1553B Communication Faults Resolution Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper introduces a method to solve the faults of the 1553B communication protocol. The 1553B is a serial communication protocol, which is widely used in aviation, spaceflight, military and other fields. This paper first introduces the basic principles and characteristics of the 1553B communication protocol, describes the types of faults and methods to solve the faults, and proposes a method to add a power-on reset in the software to solve the 1553B communication faults caused by PCI bus reset time earlier than FPGA logic software loading time. Finally, this paper analyzes and locates the faults through the fault tree diagnosis method. The validity and feasibility of adding power-on reset in software to solve 1553B communication faults, which is verified through experiments and provides a new idea and method for solving the 1553B communication faults.

articleTitle: Visual Servo Based on YOLOX-Tiny and Low-Cost Robotic Manipulator with Joints Angle Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The robotic manipulator is being used in an increasingly wide range of fields requiring automation, especially to solve repetitive tasks. The visual servo system with visual feedback can control the robotic manipulator for object tracking, grabbing, and other actions. The visual servo system is mainly composed of a vision and robotic manipulator system. The vision system involves machine learning, deep learning models, etc. The robotic manipulator system involves the inverse kinematics of the robotic manipulator, joint angle estimation, etc. This paper uses the YOLOX-Tiny model in the visual servo system, and a low-cost steering robot arm scheme is adopted. YOLOX-Tiny and SIFT algorithms deployed in Jetson Nano can still achieve the visual system's sufficient frame rate recognition of target objects and feature points. For the robotic manipulator system, if the joint angle of the robotic manipulator composed of low-cost steering engines cannot be obtained, this paper uses the PWM duty cycle output by the controller to estimate it approximately. In the experiment, the two can better control the robotic manipulator, realize the tracking of the target object, and reflect the high control robustness.

articleTitle: Research on Packet Loss Rate Measurement Method for TSN Network Under Heavy Load Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper provides a reference architecture, measurement method steps, and specific implementation methods for the measurement system of the bidirectional shortest delay link in time sensitive network systems, which is implemented using genetic algorithms. This provides a method reference for quickly and efficiently determining the shortest latency bidirectional link in situations with many links and provides a theoretical basis for system implementation.

articleTitle: Design and Application of a Portable Electric Power Distribution Gateway Operation and Maintenance Test Tool Based on Cloud Edge Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As the key equipment of the intelligent electric power distribution room, the electric power distribution gateway is the main equipment to realize the distribution IoT. In order to ensure its normal operation, regular operation and maintenance are required. At present, the research on the operation and maintenance technology of the intelligent electric power distribution room mostly focuses on the detection of the communication protocol of the intelligent terminal and the design of the operation and maintenance master station platform, while the research on the on-site operation and maintenance tools of the electric power distribution gateway is difficult to find. Therefore, this paper studies this technology. First, based on the architecture of” cloud management edge and end” of the electric power distribution IoT, the automatic closed-loop test architecture of cloud edge collaboration is designed, and the cloud edge collaboration function of the portable operation and maintenance test tool is defined. Secondly, the software and hardware design as well as the portable design of the on-site portable operation and maintenance testing tools were elaborated, ensuring the lightweight and portable operation and maintenance tool while ensuring the cloud edge collaborative operation and maintenance testing function. Finally, the feasibility of the technology is verified by field application, and the intelligent operation and maintenance level of the electric power distribution gateway is greatly improved.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Multimodal Feature Fusion Approach for Assessing English Study
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the advances in big data and AI technology, machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) have become popular in research and application. ML uses data analysis to recognize patterns and make predictions, while DL uses artificial neural networks to learn complex data representations and solve complicated problems. In the field of education, AI methods are gradually being applied. This article proposes a method based on the fusion of multimodal features to evaluate student learning in an English course. This method extracts and fuses weighted features from the three modalities of students' head movement, participation in discussions, and correctness of exercises. This practical approach can improve teaching strategies and the quality of instruction while providing a more comprehensive understanding of student learning.

articleTitle: High-quality Approximation of the Fermat Spiral with Polynomial Function
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To make the Fermat Spiral suitable for the needs of industrial design systems, a high-quality polynomial approximation method is given. The new algorithm is based on s power series. First, the definition of s-power series is reviewed, and the conversion matrix between s-Power and Bézier forms is discussed; then the hermite interpolation approximation algorithm of Fermat's spiral is given using s-power, and finally the algorithm is described in detail. The correctness and validity of this approximation algorithm are verified by an example, and it can be used in computer aided design.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer Cloud Intelligent Network Technology in Power Grid Digital Construction and Operation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the design and development of all-digital power supply integrated management system. Its goal is to manage the transmission and distribution network in an integrated way, and effectively overcome the “information island” phenomenon in China's current power grid. This system consists of large screen display system, 3D display system, 3D simulation system, security system, power management system, energy management system, energy management system, and power distribution management system. The test results show that the software can make the production operation and maintenance management of distribution network more intelligent. And it can provide good technical support for enterprise marketing.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of ARIMA Model Based on Time Series Analysis in Smart Water
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$a$</tex> smart water system, detecting water leaks is crucial, especially detecting outliers in the difference between inlet and outlet water flow in 8 virtual zones. This study chooses the ARIMA model in time series analysis to address this problem. The ARIMA model processes the data though autoregressive (AR), moving average (MA), and differential to complete model identification and order determination and perform stationarity and white noise tests. This model effectively identifies and handles outliers, typically detected through autocorrelation function (ACF) and partial autocorrelation function (PAC F) analysis. Outliers may appear as significant peaks on the ACF and P ACF plots or points beyond the confidence interval. Explaining the type of outliers is helpful for subsequent analysis. We also analyze each outlier in detail to examine the optimization and model tuning, R-squared, and the significance of data stability in each region. Finally, model visualization is performed to evaluate the model fit of time series analysis. These steps will help to solve the problems that occur in water leakage detection efficiently.

articleTitle: Student Learning State Detection System Based on Facial Expression Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper introduces a student learning status monitoring system based on facial expression recognition technology. Based on the changes in facial features of the eyes and mouth, the study focuses on the learning status of students, and on this basis, a student learning status detection system based on facial features is designed. The student learning status monitoring system developed in this project can analyze the classroom learning status of students by identifying and analyzing their facial expression data in the classroom. Scientific and multi-dimensional analysis results can help teachers find more effective classroom teaching methods, thereby achieving targeted improvement of student learning efficiency in the classroom.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Component Image and Trajectory Recognition Method of CAD Electronic Drawing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the vectorization problem of 2D project CAD graphics, vectorization algorithm is studied based on graphic description and topological relationship between graphics. A multi-class object instance partition algorithm is studied to realize the automatic recognition of the sub-object instance by using the ring partition feature in the image. The identification of topological relationship between target instances based on connection domain label is proposed. The object instance is identified and divided accurately, and then the connected region is marked to determine the connection line, and then the topological structure of the object graph is obtained. In this way, the geometric and topological information of the target graph can be extracted. Experimental results show that this method can realize the topology recognition of graph objects and graphs well. It has strong robustness to the phenomena such as broken lines and blurring that often appear in graphics. A method for 3D solid modeling is presented. This method will provide a new idea for 3D solid modeling of complex surfaces.

articleTitle: Research on Data Enhancement Analysis of Battery Management System Based on Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As new energy vehicles enter a new era, the battery management system has entered a stage of high-quality development. Focusing on the idea of data-driven intelligence, it is necessary to propose data enhancement propositions that better meet the data needs of battery performance evaluation and optimization. A theoretical analysis framework for battery data enhancement is constructed according to the internal logic of GAN (Generative Adversarial Network), which can explain the battery data enhancement mechanism jointly generated by the confrontation mechanism and collaborative mechanism involving the generator and discriminator is based on the dynamic evolution of GAN data enhancement development. And the effectiveness evaluation and practical application of battery data enhancement continue to explore the possibility of moving towards the goal of high-quality battery development. Battery data augmentation aims to provide data that meets the expected battery management system standards and continuously improves data quality and utilization. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the data generation based on the GAN neural network, construct the mechanism of interaction and matching between GAN structure and battery parameter value range, and establish the evaluation system of GAN training error and data enhancement effect, to realize the high-quality development of battery data enhancement, promote the intelligence of battery management system, and finally truly meet the data needs of battery performance evaluation and optimization.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Algorithm Based on Adaptive Threshold Segmentation: Innovative Application of BIM Technology in Digital Preservation of Chinese Palatial Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel deep learning algorithm for the digital preservation of Chinese palatial architecture. Our approach is based on adaptive threshold segmentation and 3D Convolutional Neural Networks (3D CNN), combined with Physics-based Rendering Techniques. This method effectively handles the complex structures and details of palatial architecture images, achieving high-precision image segmentation and 3D reconstruction. Experimental results demonstrate that our algorithm excels in preserving architectural details and enhancing visual realism, especially in rendering effects. Despite increased resource consumption, the algorithm shows great potential in the application of digital preservation of palatial architecture. Future research will focus on further optimizing the efficiency of the algorithm and enhancing the realism of the model.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection on Railway Track Using Haralick Feature for Color Mapping Co-Occurrence Matrix
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Surface anomalies on railway tracks pose safety hazards to the operation of high-speed trains. Employing advanced target detection techniques to identify and track anomalies revolutionizes traditional manual detection methods, enhancing detection speed and objectivity. However, the outdoor deployment of railway tracks renders them susceptible to variations in sunlight, leading to a decrease in the accuracy of target detection. To mitigate the impact of lighting changes on the recognition of surface anomalies on railway tracks, this study initially transforms RGB images of tracks into six other color models, including HSV, HSI, YCbCr, Lab, YIQ, and LUV, and extracts color model components unrelated to brightness. Haralick Feature for color mapping co-occurrence matrix is then utilized as an anomaly recognition feature, followed by input into three detectors-SVM, Random Forests, and AdaBoost-and evaluation using metrics such as TP, TN, FP, and FN to assess the recognition results of different color models across various detectors. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in identifying track anomalies, with the Cb-Cr component of the YCbCr color model exhibiting superior performance among all color models, achieving accuracies of 0.976, 0.988, and 0.988 across the three detectors, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Performance Evaluation and Improvement of Deep Reinforcement Learning in Traffic Scene Target Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As deep reinforcement learning enters a new era, object localization in traffic scenes has become increasingly important. This paper proposes an active detection model of traffic objects based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to optimize target detection performance. By constructing a deep Q network, target locations are positioned for specific traffic object categories, and top-down target reasoning is achieved by learning a series of specific conversion actions. During the implementation process, the image data set is used to train the model and analyze the action space, state space and reward function. Experimental results show that the model exhibits high accuracy and performance in positioning traffic lights and traffic speed limit signs. This paper summarizes that the active detection model of traffic objects based on deep reinforcement learning has good target detection capabilities, performance, and potential application prospects in traffic scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Sports Event Video Retrieval System Based on Harris Corner Detection Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: USB2.0 is used to design the video retrieval system for sports events. The system uses image sensor as data source, including data transmission, real-time display and corner capture. The detection principle and implementation method based on Harris operator are presented and its performance is analyzed. An image segmentation method based on cumulative frames is proposed, which can recognize different types of images well. Finally, Harris Angle is extracted from the video of various sports games by MATLAB software. In this project, an automatic corner extraction method based on multi-scale features is proposed to solve the problems of missing corner information, position deviation and easy to be disturbed by noise in traditional methods. The experiment shows that the Harris corner extraction technique is fast, consistent and accurate in image segmentation. It has great practical value for the actual image processing.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Power Information Security Engineering Evaluation Model System Based on Big Data Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: There is still a lack of perfect information security evaluation system and method in China's power network. In this paper, the power network security evaluation method is established. In this way, the security evaluation of data nodes is realized. The evolution law of cellular automata is extracted by multi-layer feedforward neural network, and the failure probability on different space-time scales is obtained. The steps and components of terminal safety evaluation of power system are given by means of evaluation target TOE technology. The simulation results show that the evaluation method is effective.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Residual Network for Pneumonia Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Pneumonia, a global health disease, continues to threaten human life. In this challenge, accurate and rapid diagnosis not only contributes to treatment effectiveness, but also reduces the burden on the healthcare system. With the development of medical imaging technology, chest X-ray image has gradually become an important tool in the diagnosis of pneumonia. However, the surge in the number of pneumonia patients has challenged traditional diagnostic methods with time and resource constraints. Deep learning, particularly convolutional neural networks (CNNs), shows potential for problem solving in this context. However, the traditional CNN model has large parameters and is not suitable for resource-constrained devices. Therefore, this study proposes a lightweight residual network (LR-Net) that combines residual network (ResNet) and depth-separable convolution (DWConv) for early and automated detection of pneumonia in chest X-ray images. Focusing on the binary classification problem (pneumonia and normal), the model was tested on the ChestX-ray2017 dataset with an accuracy of 86.49%, model parameter of 268.098 K and FLOPs of 732.2184 M. This lightweight model greatly reduces the demand for computing resources and memory, making it ideal for mobile devices and edge computing devices. Taken together, the findings of this study demonstrate the effectiveness of lightweight deep learning models combining ResNet and DWConv in pneumonia diagnosis, providing clinicians with a powerful tool to enhance diagnostic insight into pneumonia. In addition, due to its lightweight nature, the model offers new possibilities for the rapid and accurate diagnosis of pneumonia in resource-constrained settings, helping to reduce the strain on global healthcare systems and provide patients with timely treatment.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Update Method of Digital Twins for Physical Entities State Changes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Constructing real-time, high-precision depictions for changing physical entities is a current challenge in digital twin research. However, existing research on digital twins updates through real-time data is still insufficient in terms of update speed and effect. To address this, this paper proposes an adaptive updating method that can help digital twins quickly adjust according to changes in the physical entity. The method consists of two components: an Adaptive Training set Construction Algorithm and a dual-ended update mechanism. By choosing more representative new data, the Adaptive Training set Construction Algorithm can optimize the speed and effectiveness of digital twins updates; The dual-ended update mechanism can further optimize the update speed through refining the digital twins updating procedure. Comparative experiments with existing methods show that our method can help the digital twins learn more knowledge in a shorter time and better adapt to changes in the physical entity.

articleTitle: Delay-Aware Communication Service Strategy in USV-assisted Maritime MEC Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) play an important role in maritime communication systems, which can improve coverage and communication quality. In this paper, a novel USV-assisted offshore edge computing model is proposed to support time-constrained and low-resource offshore equipment communication and computing. The USV-equipped with computing resources can provide computing services to nearby user equipment. Specifically, we consider the maneuverability of the unmanned vehicle and jointly optimize the user variable, the unmanned vehicle's sailing speed and angle, and the task-offloading ratio to maximize the processing delay under the constraint of energy consumption. Considering the non-convexity, multi-dimensional state space, and continuous action space of the problem, a learning rate decay Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm (DPPO) is proposed. Experimental results show that compared with other algorithms, the proposed algorithm can output the global optimal strategy in processing delay.

articleTitle: Research on Automation System of IoT Data Access Architecture for Power Transmission and Transformation Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper presents a secure terminal architecture for power system big data. This paper analyzes the structure of the system in detail from three aspects: user layer, big data analysis layer and terminal collection layer. The architecture of information security terminal is used to complete the overall architecture of the system. In addition, it uses database firewall, database management backup, access control and password management mechanism to complete the design of database security defense mechanism, so that the disaster recovery radius can be improved, so that the fault can be effectively eliminated. Through the bidirectional cooperation of data flow and service flow, the cooperation of bidirectional data flow and service flow from bottom up and top down is realized, and the extensive and deep value mining of client data is finally realized. Experiments show that the system can effectively reduce the fault diagnosis cycle of the system, speed up the diagnosis efficiency of the system, and ensure the information security of the system.

articleTitle: Oil-paper Insulated Power Transformer PD Highly Sensitive Monopole RF Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Addressing the challenges associated with the application of built-in antenna sensors in operational transformers, such as limited gain, and the limited capability of external antenna sensors to detect internal PD signals in transformers, which suffer from low sensitivity and susceptibility to external environmental interference, this paper proposes the design and optimization research of a miniaturized, high-gain monopole ultra-high frequency antenna sensor. This research employs methods such as miniaturization, hollowing out processing, and altering the structure of the monopole grounding plate. Through simulation studies, the effects of transformer insulating oil and insulating gas on antenna performance were investigated. The simulation results show that the volume of the antenna is only 140.4 mm×72 mm×0.4 mm. In the 0.3 GHz to 3 GHz frequency band, the antenna's standing wave ratio is generally less than 5. At three center frequencies of 1 GHz, 1.5 GHz, and 2 GHz, the lowest gain is +1.2, the highest gain can reach +2.71, and the average maximum gain can achieve + 2.0. Additionally, the antenna exhibits good radiation directivity and symmetry, meeting the current performance requirements of PD UHF sensors in oil-paper insulated power transformers.

articleTitle: Enhancing Vehicle Detection in Aerial Images Through Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Introducing a drone image vehicle detection method, it is specifically devised to counter challenges posed by intricate backgrounds, multispectral variances, and numerous minute targets. This approach incorporates adaptive convolutions within the backbone's C2f module, dynamically adjusting kernel sampling points, enhancing feature portrayal for multi-scale and crowded objects. Incorporation of the Biformer attention mechanism within the bi-directional feature pyramid network utilizes sparse computations to dampen complex background effects and protect fragile small target features. We've also developed WloU-S, a unique target boxing loss function integrating angle penalties and a dynamic, non-linear focus system, boosting model flexibility and accelerating learning. Trials confirm significant improvement in detection accuracy over existing methods. Remarkably, compared to the original YOLOv8 framework, our formulation boosts the mean average precision (at 0.5 IoU) by 5.3%, coupled with a parallel increase in recall rate of 5.6%. Our method stands out as an efficient solution for drone image vehicles detection.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of Electric Control Systems Based on Fuzzy Logic and Neural Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of electrical engineering, electric control systems have entered a period of high-quality development. By focusing on fuzzy logic-based neural networks, new proposals should be submitted to meet the needs of intelligent and adaptive electric control systems. Based on the dynamic evolution of electrical control systems, we establish a theoretical analysis framework for modeling electric control systems according to fuzzy logic. It allows us to explain the integrated system state identification mechanism and performance optimization of electric control systems, including fuzzy logic and neural networks. In addition, we use numerical examples and practical deduction to explore the possibility of moving toward the high-quality development of electric control systems. The development of an electric control system is to provide electrical equipment with functions that meet expected standards. Managers are committed to continuously improving electric control systems' quality and equipment satisfaction. To this end, we have taken measures, including strengthening fuzzy logic control based on fuzzy rules and internal circulation, constructing a mechanism for interaction and learning between fuzzy logic and neural network quality perception, and establishing an evaluation system for electric control system and electrical equipment, to achieve high-quality development of electric control system, boost technological upgrading, and truly meet user needs.

articleTitle: Real-Time Multi-Camera Video Stitching Algorithm with Adaptive Sensing of Illumination and Dynamic Objects
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of digital image processing technology, the demand and application of wide-view video continue to grow. However, the existing stitching algorithms may result in unnatural appearance, misalignment, and ghosting issues when stitching scenes with inconsistent brightness or dynamic objects. To address the above problems, we propose a real-time multi-camera video stitching algorithm with adaptive sensing of illumination and dynamic objects. Within the proposed illumination compensation module, brightness equalization across varying illumination conditions is attained through the application of gain compensation to image blocks. We propose a histogram-based dynamic object detection approach to dynamically detect the presence of moving objects along the stitching seam. This method facilitates the adaptive detection of dynamic entities by analyzing the histogram disparities between the local vicinity of the stitching seam and the broader image context. The experimental results show that it can effectively solve the problem of unnatural stitching results arising from the uneven brightness of the image, and can effectively detect the presence of dynamic objects near the stitching seam so that the effect of the video stitching has been improved.

articleTitle: Research on Red Fuji Apple Grading Method Based on Improved Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In view of the problem that the grading time in apple grading research cannot meet the actual demand, the team proposed an apple grading method based on improved decision tree. Firstly, K-means clustering and threshold segmentation were used to separate the apple background. Then, five features of apple were extracted in sequence, including color, shape, diameter, texture and defects. We built a decision tree model based on the five external features of apples, and improved it with pruning operations. The results showed that the accuracy of the grading method for Red Fuji apples based on the improved decision tree was 96.75<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, which was 1.5 percentage points higher than the decision tree algorithm. This method can provide further scientific basis and theoretical methods for the research on grading of Red Fuji apples.

articleTitle: Research on CAD Model Matching Algorithm and System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In view of the problem that the local structure in the global search method of 3D model cannot meet the global features, this project intends to study the feature adjacency relationship method based on B-Rep model. By extracting B-Rep data, the feature-adjacency relationship is described. In this method, the surface, edge and other features of CAD are used to find the edge with similar features, so as to realize the segmentation of parts and CAD graphics. Comparing the adjacent matrix of the part to be recovered with that of the partitioned part can determine whether the CAD model exists or not. A general subgraph extraction method based on feature adjacency graphs is proposed to extract some features from CAD. The part to be searched is compared with the part contained in CAD, and the local similarity evaluation of the model is completed. The experiment proves that the method proposed in this paper can solve some structural problems in CAD modeling well, and the search speed can meet the demand of project search.

articleTitle: English Audio-Visual Teaching System Based on Big Data Dynamic Management
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: An English audio-visual teaching system is being researched and developed to enhance the quality of English learning and development in remote areas of China, assist minority schools in better utilizing the multimedia network teaching resources used in English instruction, and further improve the standard of multimedia network management. An audio-visual education system for English is studied, and its general structure, functional structure, and database are built using a variety of systems, including Ajax, Tornado, and jQuery technologies. The findings demonstrate that highly automated platforms for constructing English audio-visual education systems may be obtained using big data dynamic management systems. English information may be naturally imparted to students by utilizing the qualities of the combination of pictures, text, music, images, and shadow. This helps to promote students' motivation to learn and helps them study in a calm and enjoyable environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Index Modulation Technology in Optimizing Frequency Offset and Reducing PAPR in OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Expanding on the advancements in mobile communication technology, OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) has emerged as a dominant technology in wireless communication. It effectively addresses issues like frequency selective fading and multipath problems. However, OFDM systems encounter certain challenges such as frequency offset and interference, which significantly impact system performance and reliability. To mitigate these issues, researchers have proposed various improved techniques, including index modulation technology. This paper focuses on the simulation of OFDM systems with index modulation using MATLAB. The simulation results are compared with conventional OFDM systems. By analyzing the Bit Error Rate (BER) and Peak-to-A verage Power Ratio (PAPR) characteristics of OFDM systems and OFDM-IM systems with different numbers of sub carriers, the study draws the final conclusion. The findings suggest that index modulation enhances the anti-interference capability of OFDM systems while reducing PAPR. In summary, this study presents a comprehensive investigation of the impact of index modulation on the performance of OFDM systems. The results demonstrate the potential benefits of incorporating index modulation techniques to overcome the challenges faced by traditional OFDM systems, thereby improving their overall reliability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Data Processing System Based on Computer Intelligent Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The traditional 3D visual display technology only allows users to input less control data in the display process, and cannot be effectively integrated with massive data. Therefore, a visualization simulation method for 3D character animation is proposed in this paper. In terms of hardware, the 3D scanner is optimized, and the other hardware adopts the traditional system. The three-dimensional position, proportion and rotation Angle of human body are analyzed in detail. A deep learning method is proposed to realize the automatic generation of visual experience. Through the optimal processing of the completed visual comparison, the software design is completed. A visualization simulation method of 3D human body animation based on virtual reality technology is proposed. Experiments show that this method can process a large number of inputs, while the traditional processing method can only process some running data. The results show that this method can overcome the problems in the traditional method.

articleTitle: Reading Anxiety Recognition in English Classroom Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper sorts out the definition of Reading Anxiety and Eye Tracking and discusses the procedure of recognition of reading anxiety in English classroom and how CNN works for the operation of each part. CNN are characterized by powerful feature extraction capabilities, which are more suitable for expression recognition. Eye tracking technology is a technique that studies a person's mental activity by tracking and analyzing their eye movements, by which we can infer students' cognitive processing and emotional state during reading. It can be used to study foreign language reading anxiety. CNN is helpful to recommend personalized reading materials which suit students' level of difficulty and match their interest.

articleTitle: Research on Picture Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Picture quality is an index to compare the performance of various picture processing algorithms and system performance, so it is of great significance to establish an picture quality evaluation mechanism in the fields of picture acquisition, coding compression, optical imaging and so on. Picture quality evaluation can be divided into subjective evaluation and objective evaluation. This paper mainly studies objective evaluation, that is, picture quality evaluation by computer. Five picture quality evaluation indexes and their applications in various industries are introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of CRC Checksum Algorithm Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The term Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC) refers to a type of checksum algorithm used in data communication protocols to detect errors in data transmission. CRC check code can be generated and added to the transmitted message, allowing the receiver to verify the integrity of the data. This technique has become widely used in digital communication systems and networks to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data transmission. The CRC8 encoder is a digital circuit that performs error detection during data transmission. A simulation was conducted to verify its functionality, comparing output data with expected values. The results confirmed the circuit's effectiveness in accurately detecting errors and generating CRC8 values. It plays a vital role in ensuring data integrity. In conclusion, CRC is a widely used error detection algorithm with strengths and limitations in data transmission and storage systems. Ongoing research aims to enhance its efficiency and accuracy for more reliable data integrity.

articleTitle: An Improved PMF-FFT Fast Acquisition Algorithm for DSSS Signal Based on Approximate Kernel FFT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the parallel acquisition of direct sequence spread spectrum (DSSS) signal requiring a high amount of computation when there is Doppler frequency offset, this paper uses the approximate kernel FFT to replace the FFT operation of PMF-FFT acquisition algorithm, simplifies the complex multiplication method into addition and subtraction operation. And it can greatly reduce the amount of computation, and the simulation show that the acquisition performance of this improved algorithm is comparable to that of the PMF-FFT algorithm.

articleTitle: Differential Steering Control Method for Autonomous Vehicles Based on Pure-Pursuit Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As an important innovation in the automotive industry, self-driving cars are essentially wheeled robots with a variety of car models. The core of its function is the control system. The two-wheel differential drive can achieve accurate trajectory tracking and body posture control during the movement. In order to ensure accurate navigation, stability and safety, differential steering drive vehicles have been widely used in various fields. This paper proposes an automatic control scheme for differential steering vehicles based on a pure-pursuit algorithm composed of a speed loop and a steering loop. In this paper, modifying the pure following algorithm formula, a solution method of integral component integration is further proposed to solve the steady-state error problem in the automatic path tracking of small lateral error differential steering vehicles. In this method, not only eliminates the steady-state path tracking error with the minimum lateral error, but also reduces the lateral error. This research can further integrate dynamics and kinematics to achieve more accurate vehicle control.

articleTitle: Photovoltaic Forecasting with a Connected Multi-Structure Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is one of the renewable energy sources, but it is influenced by factors such as weather, season, and day night changes. Accurate predictions can help photovoltaic power plant managers better plan and adjust power generation to maximize the energy utilization efficiency of solar panels. If the output of photovoltaic power generation can be accurately predicted, it can better match the demand of the power grid and reduce energy waste. This helps to reduce the problem of load imbalance in the power system and improve the stability of the power grid. In addition, the operation and maintenance costs of photovoltaic power plants are high. By making accurate predictions, the operations team can more effectively arrange maintenance work, reduce unnecessary downtime, and thus reducing operational costs. However, the current traditional prediction methods cannot adapt well to this rapidly expanding market demand, and the accuracy of their predictions is not very good, which to some extent affects the development of related industries. To this end, we have built a CNN double _ GRU model, whose first layer is a convolutional layer, is used to extract universal meteorological data features from input data. Next are two GRU layers that return the output of each time step and the output of the last time step, which helps to capture long-term dependencies in the sequence. A Dropout layer was set between two GRU layers to reduce overfitting. Next, this paper sets the Flatten layer to flatten the output of the GRU layer, and finally performs regression prediction in the fully connected layer. The goal of the entire model is to map the input time series data to a single output that represents the prediction of photovoltaic power generation. During the training process, the model uses a mean square error loss function to measure the difference between the predicted value and the actual value, and updates the model parameters through the Adam optimizer. Through experiments, it has been shown that this model has improved in multiple indicators compared to common traditional models and neural network models in predicting photovoltaic power generation.

articleTitle: Design of Semantic Web Distributed Retrieval System Based on Rule Reasoning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Ontology technology is the core technology of semantic web, which can describe information well and retrieve described information through querying knowledge warehouses, greatly improving retrieval efficiency and accuracy. Distributed retrieval is the process of combining heterogeneous data stored on a large scale through a network, utilizing the processing capabilities of multiple machines to centrally solve collaborative indexing and retrieval problems, and ultimately forming a logical whole. Firstly, the semantic search architecture was studied; Then, the AMIE+rule inference algorithm was studied, including rules and functions, the process of AMIE+mining algorithm, and evaluation criteria; Next, the process of rule-based reasoning algorithm was studied; Finally, experimental analysis was conducted, and four algorithms including Tableau algorithm, Apriori algorithm, Rete algorithm, and AMIE+algorithm were selected for comparison, demonstrating the superiority of AMIE+algorithm and providing a basis for subsequent software system development.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Prototype Filter-based FBMC/OQAM System for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The FBMC/OQAM system, a new variant of multi-carrier modulation technology, demonstrates higher spectral efficiency and superior anti-multipath interference capabilities in high-noise environments, as compared to its predecessor, the OFDM system. As such, it is garnering interest as a potentially promising technology for 5G mobile communication systems. Bit Error Rate (BER) serves as a crucial index for evaluating the quality of the FBMC/OQAM communication system. It is influenced by various factors including the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), channel conditions, modulation methods, and coding schemes. A study into BER can facilitate a deeper understanding of the system's performance, aiding in the selection of suitable modulation modes and error correction coding schemes for practical applications, thereby improving the system's reliability and stability. Moreover, examining BER can shed light on the strengths and weaknesses of the FBMC/OQAM system, guiding optimization of its design and performance. This paper commences with the design of a prototype filter for the FBMC/OQAM system, proceeds to analyze the system and its BER expression, sets up a simulation model, and ultimately contrasts it with the OFDM system. The insights gleaned from this research are expected to propel the wider adoption and application of FBMC/OQAM as an effective modulation technology in future wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Pumped Storage Power Station with Double-Fed Variable Speed Unit Based on Reservoir Regional Operation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The conventional pumping unit lacks the ability to continuously adjust input power during pumping operations, and exhibits poor adaptability when integrating new energy sources into the grid. In this study, we propose a novel “domain operation” strategy that allocates resources based on real-time reservoir conditions across all levels of hydropower stations, while optimizing operations through the implementation of doubly fed units.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a B/S Platform Information Management System Based on Django and Vue Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Amidst the escalating ubiquity of information technology, conventional methods of managing information on B/S platforms are increasingly hindered by issues such as inefficient data transmission, cumbersome activity statistics compilation, and the absence of effective feedback mechanisms. To address these challenges, this study introduces a Volunteer Service Information Management System, engineered on the Django and Vue frameworks. This system is designed to enhance organizational and managerial efficiency of activities through automated data collection, processing, and analysis. The research employs front-end technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and the Vue.js framework, alongside back-end technologies including Python's Django framework and MySQL database. The system developed in this study significantly elevates managerial efficiency and enhances user experience by providing a more enriched information management and application experience. This research underscores the significance and practicality of B/S systems based on Django and Vue frameworks in the management of university volunteer services, offering valuable insights for future research and practical applications in related fields.

articleTitle: A PID-Based Design for Preventing Liquid Spillage during Container Transportation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Autonomous transportation vehicles are widely employed in various fields, including offices and restaurants, for tasks such as delivery. However, the use of open containers for liquid transportation poses challenges. The movement of the transporter can cause liquid spillage, leading to failed transportation objectives and potential hazards. Currently, there is a lack of a cost-effective and convenient tool that effectively prevents liquid spillage and can be applied to diverse autonomous transportation systems. To address the issue, the author conducted a mechanical analysis and kinematic modeling of container and liquid motion. It was determined that minimizing the horizontal forces exerted by the container on the liquid is vital to reducing spillage. Accordingly, the author designed a microcontroller-based PID algorithm-controlled flat carrier plate capable of tilting motion. This design aligns the force on the liquid as close to perpendicular to the container base as possible. The advantages of incorporating PID control algorithms in this design are also discussed. The design encompasses structural and program development, as well as component selection. Feasibility was demonstrated through software simulations of the design's shortest response time, along with its mechanical model. Experimental results indicate that the proposed design exhibits fast response times during dynamic processes, features a simple structure suitable for various containers and vehicles, and effectively reduces liquid spillage. By integrating theoretical algorithms, models, and practical applications, this design encourages further exploration of methods to protect transported objects in small-scale transportation systems.

articleTitle: Non-cooperative Satellite Rotation Estimation Based on Monocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The demand for on-orbit service is becoming more and more urgent in all countries of the world, and the rotation estimation of non-cooperative satellites is one of the key technologies for on-orbit service missions. In this paper, we propose a rotation estimation method for non-cooperative satellites based on monocular vision. The method first defines the key points with generalization for satellite targets in 2D images, then, by constructing a convolutional neural network, it completes the prediction of the key points to obtain the initial rotation of pose, and applies a refinement method on its basis to obtain the accurate final rotation. The experimental results show that the satellite rotation obtained by this method has high accuracy, and the method has better accuracy and generality compared with the existing satellite pose estimation methods, so it is very suitable for accomplishing the task of rotation estimation for non-cooperative satellites.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: Research on Security Analysis and Protection Measure of Internet of Vehicles Communication Protocol under Physical Layer Attack
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the Internet of Vehicles entering a new era, the IoV (Internet of Vehicles) communication protocol enters a stage of high-quality development. It is necessary to propose the IoV communication protocol propositions that better meet the communication security needs of vehicles, roads, and users, focusing on the idea of the IoV with security as the core. Based on the dynamic evolution of IoV communication protocol development, the theoretical analysis framework of IoV communication protocol security analysis and protection is constructed according to the internal logic of security, which can explain the security development mechanism of the IoV communication protocol generated by the authentication calculation and confidentiality cycle mechanism involving key distribution, channel characteristics, and machine learning. From the perspective of physical layer attack change and practice deduction of IoV communication protocol security, it is continued to explore the possibility of moving towards the high-quality development goal of the IoV communication protocol. The purpose of the security development of the IoV communication protocol is to provide communication security that meets the expected standards for vehicles, roads, and users and to continuously improve the communication protocol's security quality and security satisfaction. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen communication protocol control based on the internal cycle of communication protocol quality, develop a mechanism for interaction and protection between communication protocols and physical layer attacks, and implement an evaluation system for communication protocols and physical layer attacks. In this way, high-quality IoV communication protocols will be developed, IoV security will be promoted, and vehicles, roads, and users will be truly satisfied.

articleTitle: Condition Calibration of Hydraulic Power Station Secondary Equipment Pressure Plate Based on Faster-RCNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To address a series of problems that exist in the manual calibration of the secondary equipment platen of hydropower stations, this paper proposes the state calibration of the secondary equipment platen of hydropower stations based on the Faster-RCNN model. The efficiency and accuracy of the model in small target detection are improved by introducing the short connecting layer and feature map pyramid network; Transfer learning is introduced, where the weight parameters obtained by pre-training the model using publicly available datasets are used as the initial values for formal training, reducing the model's dependence on the original data. The experimental results show that the accuracy of the target detection model used in this paper is 90%, which is obviously better than other detection models. High-precision and high-efficiency state identification of secondary equipment platen can be realised in practical engineering inspection.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of Signal Processing System for In-Core Micro-Chamber Fission Detector CPR Nuclear Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The reactor core neutron flux of the CPR nuclear power plant is measured with a movable Micro-Chamber Fission Detector. The movable Micro-Chamber Fission Detector is a type fission chamber detector of current mode. In this paper, a Signal Processing System is designed according to the characteristics of the Micro-Chamber Fission Detector. The system includes main control unit, polarization voltage unit, current measurement unit and software. After the hardware and software design finished, the functions test of the Signal Processing System carried out. The test results show that the detector Signal Processing System meets the requirements of the specification. The Signal Processing System of Micro-Chamber Fission Detector meets the requirements of nuclear power plant as well.

articleTitle: Electric Power Data Asset Trading System Architecture Based on Double Chain Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper discusses the architecture of electric power data asset trading system based on dual blockchain. Firstly, the key technology of double chain blockchain is introduced, and its importance in the electric power data asset trading system is explained. Then, an architecture design of electric power data asset trading system based on double chain blockchain is proposed, and it is explained in detail. Then, the effectiveness of the dual-chain blockchain in implementing the electric power data asset trading system was verified through data analysis. Finally, the paper puts forward the problem of applying double chain blockchain to the architecture of electric power data asset trading system and the effective strategy of strengthening the application of double chain blockchain to the architecture of electric power data asset trading system. This research provides a feasible solution for the data asset trading system in the electric power industry, which helps to improve the transparency, security and efficiency of the transaction.

articleTitle: A Technique to Bypass RASP Protection in Java
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: RASP has become an important means of detection and defense for applications due to its ability to integrate with the application. In Java, RASP protection is generally implemented using the Instrumentation API. After an attacker has gained command execution privileges, certain methods (e.g., methods that execute system commands) can be disabled by RASP to prevent the attacker from executing them. This article aims to explore one possibility to bypass this restriction. We also explore the defenses and bypasses of this bypass method, and discuss the cost-effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Research on Recognition of Grasping Arbitrary Objects by Autonomous Mobile Robot Based on YoloX-Tiny
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As intelligent manufacturing enters a new era, autonomous mobile robots have entered a stage of high-quality development. To propose 3D positioning that better meets the needs of arbitrary position capture in the manufacturing industry, we need to focus on innovative ideas based on deep learning. Based on the dynamic evolution of RGB-D camera development, the theoretical analysis framework of 3D positioning development is built according to the internal logic of data-driven. Researchers explain the 3D positioning development mechanism jointly generated by depth model and pose estimation related to RGB-D camera and YoloX-Tiny. In addition, we will continue to explore the possibility of switching to high-image-quality development from the perspective of changing image quality and experimentally deriving 3D positioning. The purpose of developing this technology is to provide the desired results for the manufacturing industry, and researchers are committed to continuously improving the success rate and efficiency of grasping. Therefore, we take a series of measures, including object identification and positioning control based on deep information quality inner loop, constructing the interaction and coordination mechanism between the vision system and robot, and establishing the evaluation system of grasping performance and user satisfaction to realize the high-quality development of technology. It will boost intelligent manufacturing and meet the needs of the manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Network Security System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article proposes a network security system based on artificial intelligence and its protection method. The system achieves comprehensive monitoring and intelligent analysis of software behavior through the collaborative work of multiple modules, thereby improving the effectiveness and response speed of network security protection. Through software detection, behavior analysis, behavior monitoring, data storage, and other modules, comprehensive and intelligent software behavior monitoring and analysis are achieved, abnormal behaviors are accurately detected and timely processed, and the effectiveness of protection is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Non-Cooperative Space Satellite Target Position Estimation Based on HRNet Keypoint Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Non-cooperative space target position estimation has become a focus of research since human exploration of space has left a lot of space trash that poses safety issues. Compared to previous methods, deep learning-based approaches are more suited for scenes with multiple targets, complicated backgrounds, and intense lighting. This research proposes a position estimate technique for non-cooperative spacecraft in orbit, based on the HRNet network. The technique extracts feature points from the picture using a heat map, initializes the point cloud using the point-to-point connection between the feature points to generate the initial rotation matrix, and uses the point cloud alignment to estimate its position with accuracy. The pixel coordinates of important spots in a 2D picture are extracted in this article using the HRNet network. To estimate the satellite's approximate position, a mapping connection between the 2D coordinate data and the 3D model coordinates of the relevant spots is used. Point cloud alignment yields precise results for position estimation. In order to address the instability of feature extraction based on the conventional method and prevent position-matching error in the subsequent point cloud alignment, the method in this paper uses neural networks to extract the satellite's key points, obtains a better initial rotation matrix, and applies it for point cloud alignment. In this paper, the satellite's position accuracy in the simulation experiment is measured to be 2 cm, and its angle accuracy is measured to be 1 degree.

articleTitle: Research on Color Evaluation Model of Tobacco Leaf Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the tobacco industry entering a new era, the quality of tobacco leaves has entered a stage of high-quality development. It is necessary to put forward a scientific and technological proposition to better meet the needs of tobacco farmers to evaluate tobacco leaf color, focusing on adhering to the tobacco production idea centered on tobacco farmers. Based on the dynamic evolution of tobacco leaf color evaluation, a theoretical analysis framework of the tobacco leaf color evaluation model based on machine vision is constructed according to the inherent logic of machine vision, which can explain the tobacco leaf color evaluation model generated by the tobacco leaf color feature extraction mechanism involving tobacco leaf images and machine vision and the tobacco leaf color evaluation mechanism based on convolutional neural network, and continue to explore the tobacco leaf color evaluation model from the perspective of index optimization and practical deduction of tobacco leaf color evaluation. It is possible to achieve the goal of high-quality color evaluation. The purpose of tobacco leaf color evaluation is to provide tobacco farmers with information that meets the expected standards and is committed to continuously improving the quality of tobacco leaf color evaluation and improving the satisfaction of farmers. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the identification of tobacco leaf color based on the characteristics of tobacco leaf color, construct the mechanism of interaction and feedback between tobacco leaf color and machine vision quality perception, and establish the evaluation system of tobacco leaf color and principal component analysis, to realize the high-quality evaluation of tobacco leaf color, promote the improvement of tobacco leaf quality, and truly meet the tobacco farmers.

articleTitle: Analysis and Application of Meteor Burst Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to satisfy the increasing demand of valid communication methods in harsh conditions like remote places or disaster areas, this paper concentrates on meteor burst communication (MBC), which is a kind of communication technology transmitting radio through meteor trails. Meteor trail is the train remaining in the atmosphere after the passage of a meteor, forming ionized trails that can reflect radio waves. In this paper, through analyzing the principle, features, application conditions and developing trends of this technology, this paper concluded that meteor trail communication is a valid approach to link sites hard to communicate using other methods. Moreover, this paper points out some drawbacks that could be upgraded in the future, which means that MBC is able to improve its efficiency and adapt to more situations after ameliorating the existing problems. By summing up all those aspects of this technology, this paper aims to provide practical information to experts willing to improve MBC and inspire them so that a better communication network could be established with modified MBC system.

articleTitle: Construction and Retrieval Method of Power Transformation Simulation Information Knowledge Graph Based on Physical Relationship
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the substation simulation system, in order to facilitate self-learning and knowledge assistance, as well as the transfer of information between different simulation systems, it is necessary to configure the retrieval and query function of substation equipment simulation information for all types of information generated during the simulation process of substation equipment. This article proposes a construction and retrieval method of power substation simulation information knowledge graph based on physical relationships in the field of substation equipment simulation technology. Firstly, the simulation information of substation equipment is obtained, and then the knowledge graph of substation equipment simulation information is constructed based on physical equipment, systems or their components. Next, the ontological relationships and ontological attributes of the knowledge graph are extended and reasoned. Finally, the retrieval and query of substation equipment simulation information are carried out using the graph structure. Taking the simulation information of double-wound oil-immersed transformers as an example, this article illustrates the construction and retrieval method of power substation simulation information knowledge graph based on physical relationships in the field of substation equipment simulation technology.

articleTitle: Research on Fire Fighting Path Optimization of Robot Based on Artificial Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Nowadays, because of its universality and unpredictability, fire is still one of the major disasters endangering the safety of people's lives and property. With the progress of the times, informatization and intelligence are developing in all walks of life, and the same is true in the field of fire rescue. Because the robot has the characteristics of high temperature and smoke resistance, it can use the robot to go deep into the fire scene and quickly determine the location of the fire, which is very important for formulating rescue plans and fire-fighting strategies. The premise for the robot to complete the task autonomously and efficiently is to optimize a safe and fast path for it. Therefore, this paper describes the robot fire path optimization problem and establishes a model. The improved ant colony algorithm, the basic ant colony algorithm and the longicorn whisker algorithm are analyzed, simulated and solved by examples. The results show that the improved algorithm has the best performance. Finally, a single objective single robot fire path optimization system is designed, quickly providing the best fire-fighting path scheme.

articleTitle: AQM/PID Congestion Control Algorithm Simulation Experiment Design
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: AQM plays an important role in network congestion control. PID algorithm is used as the controller of AQM due to the combination of proportional, integral and differential control links, and has excellent performance in solving link congestion problems. Aiming at the problem that the principle of PID algorithm is abstract and difficult to show in traditional network experiments, the NS-3 simulation experiment platform is introduced. By building a 20x20 dumbbell-shaped network topology, we need to simulate real-world network congestion, track the queue length of routers in the bottleneck network and conduct experimental analysis on it.
