It is intuitively verified that the PID algorithm has excellent congestion control performance, has strong stability and can adapt to the continuous change of network load extremely well. At the same time, the PID parameters can also be adjusted and optimized according to the actual network conditions. In the experimental design, the AQM congestion control model is used to make up for the defect that the influence of network parameters on congestion is difficult to display intuitively.

articleTitle: Research on Real-time Identification and Monitoring of Miners' Safety Helmets Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the advancement of industrialization, the safety protection of mines has entered the high-quality development stage. In line with human-centered thinking, we propose using technological measures to meet miners' safety assurance needs better. Based on the dynamic evolution of the deep convolutional neural networks, the theoretical analysis framework of safety helmet detection is constructed according to the end-to-end internal logic. Therefore, we can describe the data collection mechanism, including video capture and image preprocessing, and the safety detection mechanism generated by the safety helmet detection and monitoring cycle mechanism. In addition, we explore the possibility of moving towards the high-quality development goal of safety helmet safety protection from the perspective of performance change and practice deduction. Safety helmet testing aims to provide mine workers with standard-compliant safety protection. The concerned management strives to continuously improve the quality of safety helmet detection and improve the safety level of the mine. To this end, we have taken a series of measures, including strengthening safety helmet control based on the improved YOLOv5 quality inner loop, building a mechanism for interaction and feedback between safety helmet and mine workers' quality perception, and establishing an evaluation system for safety helmet testing and working environment. In this way, we can realize the high-quality development of safety helmet detection, improve mine safety management, and meet the needs of workers.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Methods of Intelligent Inspection Robots Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The intelligent inspection robot is capable of performing autonomous inspection tasks in complex environments. The robot's path planning is the key issue affecting its performance and efficiency. This paper studies the path planning method of intelligent inspection robots based on deep reinforcement learning. First, it describes and abstracts the inspection environment, then defines the goals and constraints of path planning, and finally introduces the framework and algorithm of deep reinforcement learning, and explains the detailed model design and implementation of reinforcement learning, including the definition of state space and action space, the design of reward functions and policy functions, as well as the structure and parameters of neural networks. Based on the analysis and discussion of simulation experiment results, the effectiveness and superiority of this method are demonstrated. This paper concludes that the intelligent inspection robot path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning can effectively solve the uncertainty and dynamics of the inspection environment, improve the intelligence and adaptability of the inspection robot, and achieve high-quality inspection tasks.

articleTitle: Research on Indoor Navigation and Emergency Response Scheme Design of Rail Transit Station Using Virtual Reality Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of urban rail transit systems, indoor navigation and emergency response have become vital issues. Based on the virtual reality fusion technology, and with deep learning and principal component analysis, this paper proposes the indoor navigation and emergency response scheme for rail transit stations. Deep learning neural network is used for scene recognition, and principal component analysis extracts indoor scene features. The results of numerical examples show that the scene feature values, scene complexity, deep learning network parameters, and positioning errors of different sample libraries impact the results of navigation and emergency response. This paper reveals the mechanism of indoor navigation and emergency response of rail transit stations through a theoretical analysis framework. At the same time, we emphasize quality control, interaction mechanism construction, and evaluation systems. In the context of high-quality development, this paper provides theoretical support to meet the needs of urban rail transit systems in the new era. It improves the possibility of achieving high-quality development goals.

articleTitle: Integrating Advanced Neural Techniques in Educational Data: Attention-Enhanced LSTM and AGCN for Time Series and Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence and machine learning across various domains, their application in educational data analysis has gained increasing attention. This paper proposes a method that combines Attention-Enhanced Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) and Adaptive Graph Convolutional Networks (AGCN) to meet the specific needs of educational data analysis. Our goal is to deeply explore and analyze the educational funding data in Western China using these advanced techniques, aiming to uncover time series trends and hidden group patterns. Our analysis of educational funding data reveals that the attention-enhanced LSTM significantly improves the processing of time series data, especially in cap-turing dynamic changes and important features over time. The adaptive graph convolutional network effectively unveils complex relationships between different educational entities, providing a new perspective for cluster analysis. Integrating these two techniques, our method can more accurately predict and interpret the trends in educational funding allocation, offering valuable insights for policy makers. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method in educational data analysis, particularly in terms of prediction accuracy and pattern recognition. This research not only extends the application of neural network technology in the field of education but also provides data support for the formulation and optimization of educational policies.

articleTitle: Small Target Pest Detection Algorithm Based on Channel and Spatial Collaborative Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Crop pest is one of the unavoidable problems in agricultural production, which can cause serious yield loss and quality reduction, and even jeopardize the growth and development of crops and life safety. However, conventional target detection algorithms for pest detection generally suffer from generally small target sizes, complex backgrounds, and high leakage rates. To address the issues, we propose a small target pest detection algorithm CSCA-YOLO (Channel and Spatial Collaborative Attention-YOLO) based on channel and spatial cooperative attention. Aiming at the problem of small target size for pest detection in real field environments, a small target detection head is designed. And based on the integration characteristics of small target pests, a lightweight and efficient attention mechanism named CSCA is proposed, which adopts a tri-branch design to concurrently deduce crucial information across channel, height, and width dimensions. Attention, and feature fusion with adaptive weights significantly improve the small target pest detection accuracy with low computational overhead.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Contrastive Learning Networks for Graph Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The detection of anomalies in attributed networks has attracted significant attention because of the versatile applications of utilizing networks to simulate intricate systems. Emerging developments in deep learning-driven anomaly detection techniques exhibit potential, particularly in networks characterized by attributes of high dimensionality and intricate formations. Nevertheless, existing methods, which primarily rely on graph autoencoders, might not fully utilize the wealth of data present in the network, leading to less than optimal performance. Moreover, these approaches often lack a direct focus on detecting anomalies during their learning objectives as well as may struggle to expand effectively to magnify networks because of the exhaustive educating process involving the entire graph. To address these limitations, we introduce the Multi-scale Contrastive Learning Networks for, Graph Anomaly Detection (MCLGAD for abbreviation) framework. This framework leverages a self-supervised learning with contrastive methods approach to enhance anomaly detection on networks with attributes through focusing on contrasting two sub graphs to effectively capture local information and relationships within the network. By sampling carefully designed instance pairs and training the contrastive learning model, MCLGAD aims to uncover various anomalies present within networks by learning matching patterns and diverse mismatching scenarios. The framework is specifically designed to provide discriminative scores for ranking anomalies, making it well-suited for analyzing large-scale network data. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of MCLGAD compared to various baseline methods in graph anomaly detection tasks. Our implementations are available at https://github.com/jza123/MCLGAD/tree/5052d48d7cddd8cf530926d12ba64da3ea5ace46/MCLGAD.

articleTitle: A Vertical Distribution Descriptor Based on Static Point Cloud Map Building from 3D LiDAR Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Static maps are essential for the proper functioning of autonomous mobile platforms. However, dynamic objects may occur during mapping, leaving artifacts that can affect downstream tasks such as navigation and localization. We propose a dynamic objects removal algorithm based on vertical distribution descriptors (VDD) to solve this problem. Firstly, the regions of interest in the current LiDAR frame and submap are divided into multiple unit spaces to ensure low execution time of the algorithm. The VDD is computed for each unit space, and the Bhattacharyya coefficient is used to compare the differences between corresponding unit spaces and identify dynamic regions. Finally, to reduce the misidentification of static points, the ground points of the dynamic region are extracted to restore it to the static map. Using the Semantic KITTI dataset for validation, the results indicate that our method can effectively and robustly filter dynamic points.

articleTitle: APT-DFLC: A Defense System Framework against APT Attack for High Security Level Network Based on Life Cycle
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: APT attacks with concealment features and zero-day vulnerability utilization have become a major threat to high-security network environments such as government, finance and energy institutions. However the existing APT attack detection and defense methods based on dynamic analysis, anomaly detection and machine learning are mostly aimed at a single stage, this is obviously not enough for APT attack with multiple links and multi-stage characteristics. It is a meaningful work to study how to prevent APT attack comprehensively and deeply. This paper firstly reviews and analyzes the APT attack life cycle and APT attack defense mechanism of high security level network, then puts forward the defense system framework of APT attack for high security level network based on life cycle. This framework has the characteristics of full cycle, multi-level, and systematic defense deeply, which can prevent APT attacks from multiple dimensions. And we also analyzes the key problems of each part of defense. Our framework will provide the ability for high security level network to defense the complex multi-source APT attacks.

articleTitle: Simple Neural Network Fits the Aerodynamic Parameters of the Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: During the flight of the aircraft, whether the aerodynamic parameters can be obtained accurately and in real time will directly affect its flight state. The traditional method of obtaining aerodynamic parameters has the problems of time-consuming calculation and slow response. However, the general neural network method needs to consider many factors such as the aerodynamic shape and flight altitude of the aircraft. In this paper, a simpler and more convenient network is designed by combining the advantages of the two methods, which not only has high response characteristics but also can effectively fit the coefficients of the aircraft without considering the shape of the aircraft. The simulation results show that the neural network not only has excellent fitting generalization ability, but also can be better applied to the flight experiment of the flight mission with the predicted aerodynamic parameters. Neural networks convert complex calculations into linear operations, greatly improving the speed of data prediction and making the overall response faster.

articleTitle: Robust Coordination and Optimal Allocation of Renewable Energy Distribution Based on Carbon Footprint
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: “Zero carbon in electricity” is an important support to achieve the goal of double carbon. The uncertainty of a high proportion of renewable energy has brought new challenges to distribution network planning. Based on this, this paper establishes a robust coordinated optimal allocation model of renewable energy distribution based on carbon footprint. First, we need to determine the full life cycle carbon footprint coefficient of all kinds of renewable energy. Then, considering the constraints of various renewable energy allocation and operation, the optimization goal is to minimize the carbon emission penalty cost of distribution network and the installation cost of renewable energy, and the original model is quickly solved after mixed integer second-order cone convexity by means of second-order cone. In order to deal with the uncertain output factors of renewable energy, a data-driven hierarchical distributed robust optimization programming model is constructed. Combined with the typical historical data of renewable energy, the uncertain output probability distribution fuzzy set is constrained by KL divergence, and the optimal allocation scheme is solved by column and constraint generation (CCG) algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified based on ieee33 node system.

articleTitle: Analysis of Air Defense Weapon Command and Control Network Construction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The command and control network structure of air defense weapon is the basis of effective command and control of air defense weapon. Based on the analysis of the nodes and types of information flow of command and control network of air defense weapon, this paper puts forward the information flow model and information transfer model of complex air defense network, designs the algorithm of building the integrated complex network of air defense weapon system, and puts forward the index of evaluating the performance of integrated complex network. As for the function and further use of genetic algorithm to optimize and compare the parameters, we need to verify the advantages of the algorithm. The established model and the proposed algorithm can provide theoretical support for the construction of command and control network of air defense weapons.

articleTitle: Span-Based Joint Entity and Relation Extraction Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In response to the low accuracy of relationship extraction triplets in the current field of natural language processing, this paper proposes an improved model based on span for joint entity and relation extraction. Firstly, after receiving a text corpus, sentence and word representations are obtained through BERT preprocessing, and candidate entities are obtained through the span classifier; Rate different entities and filter them through span filters to obtain the real entities. Secondly, we need to concatenate entity pairs and their context into a relation classifier, add an additional linear layer to enter the bilinear layer classifier and then predict each predefined relation category through an activation function. Finally, by setting a confidence threshold to filter out the relations between entity pairs, a relation triplet is obtained, which extracts valuable hidden information from the text to support the implementation and improvement of other tasks. After training the proposed model on a predefined dataset, it was validated on the CoNLL04 dataset. The experimental results showed that the improved method proposed in this paper outperformed the baseline model, achieving an F1 value of 86.93% for entity recognition and 71.65% for relationship extraction.

articleTitle: Flight Track Data Transmission and Visualization System Based on OpenGL and AFDX
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To detect and observe the processing results of flight track data by embedded systems, this paper presents a flight track data transmission and visualization system based on Open Graphics Library (OpenGL) and Avionics Full Duplex Switched Ethernet (AFDX). We first realize the visualization of flight scenes, design a 3D flight track generation program, and dynamically simulate multiple aircraft tracks, which serve as a data source for the embedded processor. Integrated interconnection of host and embedded processor is carried out using AFDX, aircraft track data source is sent through virtual links, and result data processed by embedded is received simultaneously. The host application program is developed for data processing such as collision detection in protected airspace, and the running results of embedded programs are superimposed and displayed, to realize the three-dimensional visualization of flight tracks in the airspace of the flight scene. The simulation and the joint test indicated that the system performed well and successfully transmitted data between the host and the embedded processor. The system is capable of showing the processing results of 3D track data by plotting 3D track curves and providing great assistance in developing integrated modular avionics embedded systems.

articleTitle: Research on AI Algorithm to Improve Visual Communication Fidelity in the Meta-universe
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper focuses on the key role of artificial intelligence technology in constructing and optimizing meta-universe visual experience, especially the cutting-edge algorithm research in improving the fidelity of visual communication. With the rise of the concept of meta-universe and the deepening of practice, immersive virtual environment has put forward higher requirements for the realism and delicacy of visual effects. We explore a range of AI-based image generation, rendering and optimization algorithms, including but not limited to deep learning-driven super-resolution technology, physics engine combined lighting simulation algorithms, and machine learning-based real-time scene understanding and dynamic adaptation strategies. Through in-depth analysis and empirical experiments, we show how these AI algorithms can help improve texture details, light and shadow effects, realistic character movements in the meta-universe, and even achieve real-time visual adjustments based on user behavior and environmental changes. At the same time, the paper also discusses the possible challenges and potential solutions of these technologies in the future development and application of the meta-universe, and strives to provide theoretical support and technical reference for the construction of a more real, vivid and intelligent meta-universe visual environment.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Scheme for Vegetable Products Based on Intelligent Algorithm and Stochastic Planning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of the national economy, the superstore has a higher and higher position in the national economy, and its role is also expanding, and to open a supermarket, the purchase of goods and pricing is a crucial part. The decision to purchase goods and the rationality of pricing directly affects the profitability of the superstore. In this paper, for a superstore, we respectively study the pricing scheme of vegetable major purchase and the pricing scheme of vegetable single product purchase. First, by dividing the time interval, the mean, variance, kurtosis, skewness and other indicators of sales and sales volume of commodities are analyzed by Pearson's correlation in each time interval. Then, the sales volume of each vegetable item in each time interval was used as the weight to derive the cost-plus price and total transportation loss rate of each category of vegetables. And the input price and market demand of vegetable categories obeyed the normal distribution using the chi-square test, and the price of each category of vegetables and the market demand were fitted to the normal distribution function through the great likelihood fitting method. And the objective function was taken to maximize the profit, and the stochastic planning was used to simulate the fluctuation situation of the input price and the demand in the market, in order to simulate the market demand. Using stochastic programming to simulate the fluctuation of market price and demand, the upper limit of market demand can be used as a constraint to establish a stochastic programming model of vegetable purchase pricing for solving. Finally, we need to set up the vegetable category ordering pricing model to solve the parameter indicators, with the maximum profit as the objective function, the minimum vegetable single product purchase types as a sub-objective, coupled with the total number of saleable single product limit, order the minimum display limit and the maximum market demand as a constraint, that is, multi-objective vegetable single product purchase pricing stochastic planning model, the solution, which can be obtained to find the optimal purchasing program and pricing strategy.

articleTitle: ALM: Adaptive Local Mimic for Edge Microservice
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Edge microservice involves deploying microservice systems in edge networks, which offers the advantages of flexible development and proximity to users, making it receiving widespread attention. However, their inherent characteristics also render them susceptible to significant threats from backdoors and vulnerabilities. In this paper, adaptive local mimic (ALM) is proposed for edge microservice to mitigate security risks. Firstly, a microservice mimic defense architecture is built based on the principles of mimic. Secondly, a local mimic method is introduced to reduce the cost of mimic defense. Thirdly, a mimic node quantity selection strategy is presented based on game theory, aiming to achieve an optimal strategy using Nash equilibrium. Experiment results show that the proposed method offers high security at minimal cost.

articleTitle: BEVTrajNet: Bird's Eye View Trajectory Prediction in Factory Scenarios Based on LiDAR Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The growth of intelligent manufacturing has resulted in increased attention on the self-directed movement of Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) within industrial parks. These parks present a distinctive environment with a variety of specialized vehicles navigating intricate traffic patterns, which creates challenges for predicting trajectories involving dynamic objects. It is important to note that this is a complex task, as the AGV s must navigate in a manner that is both safe and efficient. Detection-based methods are susceptible to misidentifying or losing rare vehicle instances, which can have severe consequences for subsequent prediction tasks. To address this issue, we propose a new approach for projecting voxelized point cloud data onto the Bird's Eye View (BEV) perspective, which streamlines processing. This approach captures spatio-temporal information from the environment through spatio-temporal convolution, eliminating the need for traditional detection processes. The BEVTrajN et network architecture was developed and trained on the nuScenes dataset. It has demonstrated notable efficacy in terms of both computational efficiency and prediction accuracy. Additionally, it exhibits adaptability to the distinctive challenges presented by industrial park settings.

articleTitle: A Survey and Comparison of the Performance of Several Index Modulation Optimization Schemes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the era of the explosion of mobile data services, global communication workers aim to provide better mobile communication services and promote the development of emerging fields. Based on this, index modulation has been developed. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive survey and comparison of some of the most promising IM optimization schemes, including OFDM-IM-SL, OFDM-IM-SM, OFDM-IM-MSC, ML-Optimum Decoding and ICI Self-Cancellation technologies. The comparison is based on several evaluation metrics such as spectral efficiency, bit error rate, and energy efficiency. The findings indicate that each IM optimization scheme has its advantages and disadvantages, and the choice of a particular optimization scheme depends on specific system requirements and will be detailed talked about in this paper. Also, this paper will provide valuable insights for future research to explore the integration of multiple optimization schemes and other advanced technologies to achieve even better performance in practical applications.

articleTitle: FPGA-Based CNN Quantization Method and Hardware Acceleration Module
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the field of AI inference chips, quantization can effectively reduce the parameter size and computational cost. Additionally, the design of hardware acceleration modules can significantly accelerate the inference speed and reduce the resource consumption caused by computation and parameter storage. According to the mainstream neural network parameter structure, this paper presents a post-training quantization method. The optimal base point, which are composed of the sum of powers of 2, is determined by searching according to the Euclidean distance. Fixed-point mapping is then carried out to achieve quantization of different bit widths. Simultaneously, the matrix calculation acceleration unit is designed on the field-programmable gate array (FPGA) platform using the characteristic of power of 2 multiplication calculation. This work replaces the original multiplication calculation with shifting, significantly reducing hardware resource consumption. Experimental results demonstrate that when weight values and feature maps are quantized to 4-bits, the model compresses to 14.3% of its original size with only a 2.4% loss in network accuracy. The module for accelerating quantitative inference runs at 300MHz on the Xilinx XC7Z100 platform, resulting in a 339 times faster inference speed compared to the ARM platform.

articleTitle: Design of a Visual Detection Method for Prohibited Item Packages Detection Based on the YOLO Model
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a prohibited item package detection system based on the YOLO model. Utilizing the state-of-the-art YOLO as its core object detection model, with the integration of residual connections and deep attention mechanism, the detection accuracy for prohibited item in the test dataset can exceed 85%. The model has a certain anti-interference ability against item occlusions and X-ray imaging distortions. It can efficiently recognize and detect prohibited item in a large volume of postal item image data, and it achieves superior detection results for overlapping and occluded prohibited items. The prohibited item package detection system based on YOLO accurately identifies prohibited items, offering an effective technical solution for the postal monitoring of prohibited items.

articleTitle: RNN with attentional feedback predicts early acute kidney injury
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a prevalent complication that often arises post-surgery, especially in intensive care unit (ICU) environments and among individuals grappling with acute medical conditions. This condition poses a significant threat to life, with a heightened risk of mortality. As a result, physicians face the daunting task of closely monitoring patients' physiological parameters and laboratory findings in ICU settings. However, the complexity and volume of data involved in this process pose significant challenges for healthcare providers. With the rise of machine learning, data dimensionality reduction techniques help doctors to alleviate the pressure of monitoring data to a certain extent. The emergence of RNN(recurrent neural network) models in deep learning has shown great potential for predicting such data. In this paper we are also improving the RNN model. In previous studies, RNN models with feedback loops have appeared, and we add an attention mechanism to the feedback path, and our main idea is to use the attention mechanism to give weights to the return error from the prediction that occurs in the previous time step and then input it into the current time step to learn the prediction. We demonstrate that our improved model achieves good results using the MIMIC-III dataset and the eICU dataset.

articleTitle: Research of Optimized Denoising and Precise Segmentation Methods in Sonar Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Sonar image processing plays a crucial role in various fields such as military operations, oceanographic surveys, medical imaging, etc., where the quality of sonar images directly impacts the accuracy of subsequent data analysis and decision-making. To identify the most suitable denoising and segmentation methods for sonar image, this paper delves into the image denoising and image segmentation issues of sonar images for the image quality improvement through a comprehensive comparison and evaluation of various classical algorithms. In the denoising domain, we conducted a detailed analysis of commonly used algorithms including mean filtering, median filtering, Gaussian filtering, morphological filtering, and Fourier filtering, and objectively evaluated their performance using metrics such as peak signal-to-noise ratio and mean squared error. Experimental results indicate that median filtering excels in noise reduction in sonar images, demonstrating significant improvement in image clarity and quality. For segmentation, we compared and studied K-means clustering, maximum entropy method, OSTU's method, and OSTU's method based on connected component analysis. Through quantitative evaluation of segmentation effectiveness and qualitative analysis, we found that the OSTU algorithm based on connected component analysis performs exceptionally well in segmenting sonar images, accurately extracting target regions and laying a solid foundation for subsequent target recognition and tracking. This work introduces a comprehensive evaluation method, providing a reference for algorithm selection in the field of sonar image processing with practical and generalizable value.

articleTitle: The Problem Solving of System Distortion and Noise Signal Based on FFT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) is a widely used tool for signal analysis and processing in digital signal processing. However, the computation involved in the DFT method makes real-time processing difficult. The Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) algorithm was introduced to overcome this issue by reducing the amount of computation required. This paper discusses the problems leading to FFT system distortion and noise interference, such as insufficient or excessive sampling rates, quantization errors, poor selection of window functions, spectral leakage, and pickup noise. Recent advances in FFT, such as Non-Uniform Discrete Fourier Transform (NDFT), Zoom-FFT, and Chirp-Z transform, are also discussed as potential solutions to these problems. The paper provides a logical analysis of the causes of these problems and introduces methods to address them. The effectiveness of the window function, Zoom-FFT, and anti-aliasing filter is verified and compared. The study of these issues is crucial for the development of digital signal processing in various fields.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Vibration Suppression Technology of Overhead Wire Based on High Performance Damping
publicationTitle: 2024 4th Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Breeze vibration of overhead wire is a common problem in power industry, which may lead to fatigue fracture of wire and bring security risks to power grid operation. Therefore, the research and development of a high performance damping technology can effectively suppress the breeze vibration of overhead wire, which is of great significance to ensure the stability and reliability of power grid operation. Aiming at this problem, this paper puts forward the technology of wind vibration suppression of overhead wire based on high performance damping. A new kind of damper with new structure is designed, which can effectively suppress the breeze vibration of overhead wire.
